races.race_name: Killarney Park 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Words Unspoken
runners.spotlight: One of only three in the field with hurdling experience and he has finished well ahead of the other two; the 85,000euros yearling lost third late on at Limerick (2m1f, good), but it was a positive first-ever run and there is likely improvement to come.
runners.comment: Fared best of three in field who competed over hurdles last (fourth); improvement likely

runners.name: Cite Florale
runners.spotlight: 110,000euros yearling; two good placed efforts in Flat maidens this season; her Flat rating of 74 is one of the best in this field for her hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Two good placed efforts in Flat m'dens this year; OR of 74 is one of the best in field

runners.name: Misty Cove
runners.spotlight: Couple of okay AW runs over the winter before making a winning turf/handicap debut in May (1m3f, yielding to soft), runner-up has won since; slight concern how poor she was at Down Royal when last seen (beaten 21l); however, her Flat rating of 74 gives her a big shout here on hurdling bow.
runners.comment: Sligo h'cap winner on Flat in May but poor last time; OR of 74 gives her a big shout

runners.name: No Bother Aoife
runners.spotlight: Rated 51 on the Flat after seven runs with little success; mid-field here over 1m4f on Monday; Misty Cove is the more appealing of yard's two runners.
runners.comment: Rated 51 after seven runs on Flat with little success; trainer's other runner appeals more

runners.name: Honey Dale
runners.spotlight: Basement rating of 37 on Flat following nine unplaced runs; others preferred.
runners.comment: Basement rating of 37 on Flat following nine unplaced runs; others preferred

runners.name: Minella Buoy
runners.spotlight: Beat very few rivals in three Flat maidens last year; modest sixth of 14 on Flat handicap debut at Gowran last time; hails from a yard that means he can't be ruled out despite a Flat rating of 45; hood goes on for hurdling debut
runners.comment: Hails from a yard that means he can't be ruled out despite Flat rating of 45; hood on

runners.name: Delusional
runners.spotlight: Best of eight Flat runs came in a 1m3f handicap here in May (good) when a close third; below that level twice since; rated 62 on Flat, so may get involved on hurdling/stable debut.
runners.comment: Best of eight Flat runs came here when a close third; rated 62 so could get involved

runners.name: Private Larry
runners.spotlight: Surprise winner (20-1) on his seventh Flat start at Bellewstown last time (1m4f, good); that brings him up to a rating of 63, which still leaves him with a bit to find with a few of these.
runners.comment: Surprise winner on seventh Flat start last time; OR of 63 leaves him with a bit to find

runners.name: Divelment
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in Roscommon maidens last year and again twice on AW earlier this year; claimed for 5,000euros after disappointing in a Ballinrobe claimer in May; not too bad in a Down Royal maiden last time; rated 63 on Flat and not discounted.
runners.comment: Placed multiple times on Flat and rated 63 in that sphere; not discounted

runners.name: Connor Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly on sole Flat start and was pulled up on his first run over hurdles at Limerick, jumping lacking fluency; unlikely.
runners.comment: Ran poorly in sole Flat start and was PU in first run over hurdles; unlikely

runners.name: Notahairoutofplace
runners.spotlight: Beaten out of sight in sole Flat maiden; didn't look a natural jumper when unseating at the second on hurdling debut at Limerick (150-1).
runners.comment: Beaten out of sight in a Flat m'den; didn't look a natural jumper when UR last time

runners.name: Balance Of Trade
runners.spotlight: No wins from 12 Flat starts and rated 48 in that sphere; 18l behind Words Unspoken at Limerick on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: 0-12 on Flat and 18l behind Words Unspoken at Limerick on hurdling debut

races.race_name: Killarney Grand Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Fraher Field
runners.spotlight: Wexford bumper winner last summer and easily pick of three attempts hurdling when second to an odds-on shot in 2m Listowel mares maiden last month (yielding); later in month just okay effort in Leopardstown amateur flat maiden on fast ground; probably prefers easier ground and could struggle to confirm Listowel form with Tumbling In on these terms.
runners.comment: Listowel second probably prefers easier ground but respected
runners.owner: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen

runners.name: Tumbling In
runners.spotlight: Sister to 134-rated hurdler Dream On Baby showed potential in two bumpers last season and much better effort on hurdles debut when returning last month, effort just flattening out from last when third in 2m Listowel mares maiden; 1.25l to find with Fraher Field, but now gets 7lb from that rival and bred to relish this longer trip.
runners.comment: 1.25l to find with Fraher Field on Listowel form but now gets 7lb from that rival
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Mysilverriverfeale
runners.spotlight: Slowly improving, fair fifth over C&D in May and later in month stayed on late to chase home a hot favourite at Tramore; tongue-tie now added to hood; more likely needed to play a major role.
runners.comment: Tramore runner-up going the right way but more likely needed to play a major role

runners.name: Pets Georgina
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in bumpers last month at Sligo (2m2f, good), having previously only just been denied in a 3-finisher 3m Kilbeggan novice hurdle; yard in flying form this week, one to consider although this looks a tougher test.
runners.comment: Sligo bumper winner touched off in 3m Kilbeggan novice hurdle; this a tougher task though

runners.name: Some Pretender
runners.spotlight: Debut Galway festival bumper winner last season before running solid races for third in three subsequent Listed bumpers without showing much progress; last month's hurdles debut in 2m6f Punchestown mares maiden was tame; surely capable of better, although stamina a possible issue.
runners.comment: Decent bumper form but recent hurdles debut effort over this trip raises questions

runners.name: Chisel Hill
runners.spotlight: Nice bit of improvement on third maiden hurdle outing, left in second at the last to chase home an odds-on shot over 2m4f at Limerick in late May (yielding); definite contender if seeing out this longer trip.
runners.comment: Limerick second a definite contender if seeing out this longer trip

runners.name: Torque De Lune
runners.spotlight: Huge price when showing mild promise with a recent fourth placing at Downpatrick but unable to build on that at Limerick since; upped in trip and lots more needed.
runners.comment: Mild promise at Downpatrick but unable to build on that at Limerick

runners.name: Glenmore Graduate
runners.spotlight: Not much promise in three point-to-to-points and well held on last month's bumper debut; easily passed over now switched to hurdles.
runners.comment: Not much in points' and on recent bumper debut; best watched on hurdles bow

runners.name: Greenroad Girl
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George filly is first foal of a modest half-sister to winners Early Morning Rain (bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle), Rosa Damascena (1m2f) and Matavia Bay (1m2f); debutante best watched.
runners.comment: Order Of St George filly best watched on debut

runners.name: Another Blunder
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in all five starts; hard to make a case for on form.
runners.comment: Huge odds and well beaten in all five starts; hard to make a case for

runners.name: Daily Devotion
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in both bumpers in the spring; 4yo can only be watched now switched to hurdles.
runners.comment: Tailed off in both bumpers in the spring; 4yo can only be watched now switched to hurdles

runners.name: Jessie Roe
runners.spotlight: Moderate bumper form and two maiden hurdle runs no better.
runners.comment: Moderate bumper form and two maiden hurdle runs no better

runners.name: Uno Me I Like My T
runners.spotlight: Poor overall form including in three maiden hurdles; tongue-tie tried.
runners.comment: Poor overall form including in three maiden hurdles; tongue-tie tried

runners.name: Sonna Lady
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in maidens at Kilbeggan and Bellewstown; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in maidens at Kilbeggan and Bellewstown; best watched for now

runners.name: Keyser Smokesy
runners.spotlight: Limited level of ability hurdling in 2024 and more recent point-to-point form doesn't inspire confidence.
runners.comment: Limited ability hurdling in 2024 and recent points' form doesn't inspire confidence

races.race_name: Lee Strand Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Cobra Queen
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over both hurdles and fences on decent ground; two recent runs leave her with a fair bit to find and cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: Two recent runs leave her with a fair bit to find and cheekpieces now tried

runners.name: Idy Wood
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner over hurdles in Britain with Jamie Snowden at up to 2m5f, also a dual winner over fences; well beaten in Pertemps Final and pulled up (lost right shoe) at Haydock in April final start before bought for 18,000GBP following month; interesting to see if new yard can spark a revival, ground to suit.
runners.comment: Ex Jamie Snowden-trained; interesting to see if new yard can spark revival, ground to suit

runners.name: Kamino Bello
runners.spotlight: Sligo maiden hurdle winner last year (2m2f, good) but needs to improve a fair bit on both recent handicap efforts; steps up in trip; due to run here yesterday.
runners.comment: Needs to improve a fair bit on both recent handicap efforts; steps up in trip

runners.name: My Gaffer
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner who is rated lower over hurdles, making all over 2m7f at Clonmel in April and fair fourth here following month (2m4f); return to longer trip to suit and yard going well.
runners.comment: Fourth here in May; return to longer trip to suit and yard going well

runners.name: Elusive Ogie
runners.spotlight: Limerick maiden winner last year (2m1f, good) and finished good third in the Lartigue at Listowel; easily best run since and just beginning his challenge (going well) when unseating two out here in May in race won by Burru over 2m4f; poor Listowel run later in month and has had a break since (upped in trip).
runners.comment: Likely would have gone close here in May but for unseating two out; upped in trip

runners.name: Warriors Wood
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins came over shorter trips and off the mark chasing in 2m5f Kilbeggan handicap in May, following that up with good third in competitive 2m4f handicap at same track; clearly in good order and could go well here off 8lb lower hurdles mark.
runners.comment: In good form over fences and could go well here off 8lb lower hurdles mark

runners.name: Hees Dynamite
runners.spotlight: First reserve; three hurdle wins have been at Limerick but also won 2m5f handicap chase here last summer; absent since pulled up over fences at Limerick's Christmas meeting so may need this.
runners.comment: Absent since pulled up over fences at Limerick's Xmas meeting so may need this; reserve

runners.name: Burru
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; pair of 2m4f handicap wins, including here in May off 104; later in month didn't appear to stay this trip at Ballinrobe and loads to find with a couple of today's rivals on that run.
runners.comment: 2m4f winner here in May but didn't seem to stay 2m6f afterwards; reserve

runners.name: Moon Mission
runners.spotlight: Winner of a 2m2f Cork novice event on good ground in May, not so good in Wexford conditions event later same month; seemingly has a bit to do back in handicap company off this sort of mark.
runners.comment: Cork novice winner seemingly has a bit to do back in handicap company off this mark
runners.owner: J T O'Connor & M P Gleeson & P M Fortune & A McGonigle

runners.name: Jacovec Cavern
runners.spotlight: In fine form, winning over 2m4f at Punchestown festival and good efforts off much higher marks since, chasing home an 8l winner over this trip at Ballinrobe and not quite getting home over 3m1f when third at Kilbeggan last month; trip/ground okay and should go well again.
runners.comment: Continues in fine form; trip/ground okay and should go well again

runners.name: Magnor Glory
runners.spotlight: Capable handicap hurdler back in the day (won here in 2022 over 2m4f); series of absences in recent years, most recently good run in the circumstances when hampered by loose horse in finishing fourth in 2m4f Ballinrobe handicap chase in May; first run over hurdles in three years (11lb lower here).
runners.comment: Recent chase comeback run encouraging; first run over hurdles in 3 years (11lb lower)

runners.name: Has Me Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Got up late to win a 2m Kilbeggan maiden hurdle in September 2024 (good-to-yielding) but hasn't been seen since; very much an unknown quantity on handicap debut after such an absence and market probably best guide.
runners.comment: Absent since Kilbeggan maiden win in September 2024; market best guide on handicap debut

runners.name: Woodstream Lad
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; last of three wins for Philip Rothwell came at Downpatrick last summer (2m3f); Clonmel claiming second in May his best recent run, debuts for new yard here.
runners.comment: Wins have been over shorter; debuts for new yard; reserve

runners.name: Nas Na Riogh
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner over hurdles, including 2m4f novice here in 2024; not so effective a chaser, most recently dropping away tamely after forcing much of pace in 2m5f Kilbeggan handicap in May; blinkers now replace cheekpieces on hurdles return with a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Not so effective a chaser, blinkers replace cheekpieces on hurdles return

runners.name: Frankendael
runners.spotlight: Both hurdle wins have been at around 2m on soft ground; tame enough Listowel effort last month at similar trip, now takes a marked step up in distance and others look more likely.
runners.comment: Best form at 2m on softer ground so opposable

runners.name: Pray Tell
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins in second half of 2024 haven't been added to, including in a stint chasing; most recently creditable fourth in 2m5f Kilbeggan handicap in May; back hurdling and ideally wants softer ground.
runners.comment: Hasn't proved a natural jumper of fences; back hurdling and ideally wants softer ground

runners.name: Thornleigh Frank
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner for Mark Fahey in 2023, including over this trip at Galway off today's mark; some lengthy absences since, most recently encouraging comeback run at Ballinrobe in late May when staying-on third (Jacovec Cavern second) over this trip (good) in first-time cheekpieces; entitled to improve for that and has 4l to find with Jacovec Cavern.
runners.comment: Encouraging Ballinrobe comeback run but has 4l to find with Jacovec Cavern

runners.name: Nytol
runners.spotlight: Both hurdle wins came at Cork on good ground last year; 0-4 chasing this year, just headed when unseating two out at Limerick last time; reverts to hurdles with trip/ground to suit.
runners.comment: Unconvincing so far chasing; reverts to hurdles with trip/ground to suit

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Daily Money Back Meeting Handicap Chase

runners.name: Gaelic Arc
runners.spotlight: Won this in 2024 off 1lb higher mark and timely return to form last month under forcing tactics, winning over 2m at Punchestown and only denied by a neck off 5lb higher over 2m4f at Kilbeggan; up another 3lb but likely big player again.
runners.comment: 2024 winner in fine form of late under forcing tactics; likely big player again
runners.owner: Mark R D Fleming / T Westropp Bennett

runners.name: Jasko Des Dames
runners.spotlight: Two chase wins came in 2024 but some good runs in competitive handicaps last season, notably Grand Annual fifth and decent fourth in Red Rum at Aintree; down in grade with conditions to suit, so big player.
runners.comment: Ran well in much better-class handicaps at Cheltenham & Aintree; big player down in class

runners.name: Femme Magnifique
runners.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner for Willie Mullins in 2023-24; didn't add to her tally for Paul Kiely last year, but back to form on both recent starts for current yard in 2m handicap chases on good ground, winning at Tramore and chasing home clear winner Mic Drop off 6lb higher at Wexford; more needed to reverse that form.
runners.comment: Back to form for new yard of late on good ground; more needed

runners.name: Mic Drop
runners.spotlight: In the form of his life and seeking a hat-trick, following wins at Limerick and when beating Femme Magnifique decisively at Wexford last month (good); 2lb wrong here, but talented rider's claim offsets that; big player again, although may need to jump better now raised in class.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker 2lb wrong here but talented rider's claim offsets that; big player

runners.name: Dreal Deal
runners.spotlight: Veteran's most recent win came in this race last year off 2lb lower; rediscovered form in the spring in 2m4f veterans' handicaps, finishing fine third at Haydock and good second (having hit last) at Ballinrobe; has to be considered.
runners.comment: Last year's winner back in form in the spring; respected
runners.owner: Mark Devlin & Philip Smith & Nigel O'Hare & P J Rothwell

runners.name: No Flies On Him
runners.spotlight: Hurdles winner has been placed only twice in 12 chase starts, notably beaten a neck in 2m2f Limerick novice at Christmas on testing ground; pulled up in first-time cheekpieces (now discarded) on Kilbeggan comeback in late May and questions to answer now, especially on this quicker ground.
runners.comment: Better hurdler; questions to answer now, especially on this quicker ground

runners.name: Special Cadeau
runners.spotlight: 0-7 since winning on chase debut early last year but has faced some tough tasks in competitive handicaps, notably good third over 2m1f at Ascot in November; not much luck in running when midfield in Grand Annual in March and has had a break since; drops in class here, so has to be respected.
runners.comment: Midfield in Grand Annual; had a break since and has to be respected now dropped in class

runners.name: Drumgill
runners.spotlight: Seven career wins capped by 2m1f Listed handicap chase win at Fairyhouse last November; recent Kilbeggan runs over longer trips well below best, but yard has returned to form so could improve for this drop in trip, although yard have a more obvious contender in Gaelic Arc.
runners.comment: Recent form below best but yard have returned to form so could improve for drop in trip

runners.name: The Banger Doyle
runners.spotlight: Much better chaser than hurdler, three wins include handicaps at Punchestown and Cork in 2024; long losing run since, but has shown himself in good heart on the Flat of late.
runners.comment: On a long losing run but has shown himself in good heart on the flat of late

races.race_name: Lee Strand Novice Chase

runners.name: Net Boy
runners.spotlight: 1-5 over hurdles and rated 121; unseated at the third on chase debut at Leopardstown in March; made amends when comfortably winning at Ballinrobe last time (2m1f, good); that run gives him a shot here.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler UR on chase debut but made amends when easily winning last time; chance

runners.name: Shadow Paddy
runners.spotlight: Top-rated of these over hurdles (133), winning four from ten; trounced his four rivals on chasing debut at Limerick in May (2m4f, good to yielding), jumping fluently and travelling strongly; that was a very promising first run over fences and he can make it back-to-back wins despite dropping back in trip.
runners.comment: Top-rated over hurdles and trounced rivals on chase bow last time; he can follow up

runners.name: Cappa Hill
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps at Cork (2m1f, good) and Tipperary (2m, good to yielding) in August/October; hasn't hit the same heights in three runs since, beaten 16.5l at this track last time (2m1f, good to yielding); unplaced in three points so this switch to chasing may not bring the required improvement.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner was unplaced in three points so this switch to chasing may not improve

runners.name: Endless Talking
runners.spotlight: Improved form lately in easily winning a Downpatrick maiden hurdle before adding a Tramore beginners' chase (2m, good), keeping on well; his chase win was the least impressive of the three last-time winners, but not ruled out given his good form.
runners.comment: Improved form lately, easily winning a m'den hurdle and adding a beginners'; not ruled out

runners.name: Wing Back
runners.spotlight: 1-11 over hurdles having won a Downpatrick handicap off 86 in August (2m2f, good); made a bad mistake when tailed off on chasing bow at Wexford last time (2m4f, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: Tailed off after a bad mistake on chase bow last time; others preferred.

runners.name: Fast Felix
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back hurdle races in August/September on good ground; creditable fourth at this track in May (2m1f, good) but below that at Listowel last time; makes chasing debut, but has a lot to find with a few of these.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner has a lot to find with a few of these on chasing debut

runners.name: Piccolo Player
runners.spotlight: Won his second hurdles start at Limerick in November (2m, heavy) and placed a couple of times since then; beaten 23l off 105 at Roscommon last time on chase debut (2m1f, yielding to soft); others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Won his m'den hurdle on hvy; beaten 23l off 105 on chase debut last time

races.race_name: Europe Hotel And Resort Handicap Chase (Div I)

runners.name: Love Like This
runners.spotlight: Running for the 45th time when opening her account over hurdles at Kilbeggan (3m1f, good to yielding, 100-30 fav) last month; couldn't follow up back there next time (3m1f, good, 12-1) off 5lb higher; regular 7lb claimer has been replaced for this return to fences (0-9), but her overall profile is unappealing.
runners.comment: Opened her account at the 45th attempt but couldn't follow up last time

runners.name: Kilashee
runners.spotlight: Better hurdler than a chaser, and her last three runs over fences do nothing to dispute that; pulled up at Roscommon on her return.
runners.comment: Better hurdler than chaser and her last three runs over fences do nothing to dispute that

runners.name: Fr Gilligansvoyge
runners.spotlight: Veteran with a poor strike rate but has found his form of late, culminating in a win over nearly 3m at Downpatrick in June (good); raised 3lb but ran creditably once again down in trip at Wexford when third (2m4f, good); this trip is more suitable and he is showing good consistency at the moment.
runners.comment: Veteran has found form, culminating in a win last month; creditable third last time too

runners.name: The Dara Man
runners.spotlight: Modest strike-rate of 3-40 over fences, although one of his wins came here; latest success was in August 2024 at Kilbeggan; showed more promise returned to there last time (2m5f, yielding) when a distant third of 11; he's now 19lb below his last winning mark, but must build on his last run.
runners.comment: 3-40 over fences, 19lb below last winning OR; some promise last time but must build on it

runners.name: Lecale's Diamond
runners.spotlight: Shed his maiden tag at Wexford last time when winning a 3m handicap hurdle off 87 (good to yielding); that was his first try at a 3m trip and he won going away; didn't disgrace himself in his two beginners' chase runs last season; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Shed m'den tag over hurdles latest; didn't disgrace himself in runs over fences; chance

runners.name: Jouster
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner won a Tramore beginners' chase in 2024, but is yet to win a handicap; must improve on recent form.
runners.comment: Beginners' chase winner is yet to win a h'cap and must improve on recent form

runners.name: Malton Groove
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres after 33 starts, but was second at Downpatrick on penultimate (3m, good), 0.5l behind Fr Gilligansvoyge; sent off favourite up in grade at Wexford last time (2m7f, good), but was a modest third; in the mix on his Downpatrick run, but his record is a concern.
runners.comment: 0-33 in all spheres but was close on penultimate; not at same level last time

runners.name: Tropical Image
runners.spotlight: Sole career win came at Listowel over hurdles in September (2m6f, good to yielding); okay chase debut in a handicap here (2m5f, good to yielding) in May and improved on that when beaten just half a length back at Listowel last time in a beginners' (2m3f, yielding); this trip looks more suitable and she's in the mix.
runners.comment: Okay chase bow here and went close at Listowel last time; this trip more suitable; player

runners.name: Mobile Mamma
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; point winner got off the mark under rules when winning a novice handicap chase at Newcastle in March last year (3m, good); has raced just twice since then and ran poorly; makes stable debut off 4lb lower mark compared to her win; a tongue tie and cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Reserve; won off 4lb lower last year; poor in two runs since; makes stable debut now

runners.name: Early Arrival
runners.spotlight: Yet to win over fences, but couldn't have gone much closer at Kilbeggan when last seen in August (3m2f, good to yielding); unseen since then after pulling up unsound post-race; best watched on return unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Went close to a first chase win in Aug' but best watched on return unless market speaks

runners.name: Ladies Well
runners.spotlight: First reserve; won off 2lb lower over hurdles at Ballinrobe in August (2m6f, good); remote second of five on chase debut at Kelso on seasonal return when none too fluent in the jumping department; hampered and unseated at the fourth flight back over hurdles at Kilbeggan last time.
runners.comment: Reserve; hurdles winner was none too fluent in her sole chase outing

runners.name: Tippin And Tappin
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally over fences when winning this race last year off 8lb lower (yielding to soft) under O'Keeffe; has run just once since then, on seasonal return at Punchestown when an okay eighth of 18 in a 2m handicap hurdle (good to yielding); cheekpieces go on now and he has won on good; interesting.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 8lb lower under this rider; okay hurdles return; interesting

runners.name: Made U Look
runners.spotlight: Dual winning pointer but his form under rules isn't compelling; pulled up in a handicap chase at Roscommon last time.
runners.comment: Dual winning pointer but his form under rules isn't compelling.

runners.name: Following Orders
runners.spotlight: Some fair placed form in maiden hurdles last year on good; no impact in a pair of beginners' chases at Kilbeggan recently; cheekpieces need to get more from him on his handicap chase debut.
runners.comment: Fair placed form in m'den hurdles last year; no impact in a pair of beginners' recently

runners.name: Eddies Pride
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner hasn't visited the winners' enclosure since 2024; tailed off in two chase starts this term; unlikely.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner but nothing since 2024; tailed off in two chases this season

runners.name: Johnny M
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; poor efforts in two handicaps since returning from a long absence; makes chasing debut now
runners.comment: Reserve; poor efforts in two handicaps since returning from a long absence; chase debut

runners.name: Three County Star
runners.spotlight: No wins from 11 attempts over hurdles; one of his better efforts came in first-time cheekpieces at Kilbeggan last time when an 8.25l sixth; that headgear is retained for his chasing bow, but fences need to get more from him.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles; one of his better efforts last time in cheekpieces; chase debut
runners.owner: John P Coleman & M J Caffrey

runners.name: Annie Questions
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in point-to-points in May after 14 attempts; no impact in a handicap chase or hurdle race since then.
runners.comment: Belatedly off the mark in points in May; no impact in a chase or hurdle race since then

races.race_name: Europe Hotel And Resort Handicap Chase (Div II)

runners.name: Huntsgrove
runners.spotlight: Winner of a Sligo maiden hurdle in May last year (2m4f, good); beat precious few rivals in four beginners' chases to date; pulled up at Tramore when badly hampered at the first last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner has beaten precious few rivals in four beginners'; others preferred

runners.name: Oogum Boogum
runners.spotlight: Won a Punchestown handicap hurdle in May (3m, good) off 84 and placed twice since then; made a positive chase debut at Wexford (2m4f, yielding) in April when third off this mark, but pulled up at Tramore next time after making a bad mistake; could go well.
runners.comment: Could go well given his recent hurdles form and didn't run badly in his first chase

runners.name: Stretchemout
runners.spotlight: Winning point-to-pointer got off the mark under rules in a 2m5f Sligo beginners' chase in October (good to yielding) for Gordon Elliott; failed to build on that in three runs afterwards and no sign of a revival over hurdles at Limerick on his stable debut.
runners.comment: Point winner won a beginners' in Oct' but has been poor in four runs since then

runners.name: Parkgarve
runners.spotlight: 0-14 in all spheres; has tended to give his best at Downpatrick and was an okay 10.5l fifth of 14 on his handicap chase debut there last time (2m4f, good); needs more.
runners.comment: 0-14 in all spheres; okay 10.5l fifth of 14 on h'cap chase debut last time; needs more

runners.name: Cullenwaine
runners.spotlight: Modest strike rate of 1-21 over fences; took the runner-up spot on consecutive occasions at Limerick and Tramore in April/May, both over 2m6f on good; lesser run back at Tramore when last seen over fences (2m6f, good); poor effort back over hurdles at Limerick earlier this month.
runners.comment: 1-21 over fences; runner-up twice earlier in the year; poor over hurdles last time

runners.name: The Rebel County
runners.spotlight: Point winner easily won a Tipperary hunter chase in May last year; has been hit or miss since, but one of his better efforts came at Downpatrick last month when taking third (3m, good), making a mistake at two out; way below that level over hurdles at Limerick last time; return to fences should help.
runners.comment: Point/hunter chase winner has been hit or miss since but okay third on penultimate

runners.name: U Asking Me
runners.spotlight: Point winner and won a Clonmel handicap hurdle in 2024 (2m4f, good); not a lot to recommend him in three runs this season.
runners.comment: Point winner won a hurdles race in 2024; not much to recommend him in three runs this term

runners.name: Embrace The Day
runners.spotlight: First reserve; winner of his only point-to-point and won on his eighth hurdles outing at Listowel (3m, good to yielding) off 95, running on well; he's a big danger if getting a run.
runners.comment: Reserve; winner of only point and off the mark over hurdles last time; big danger if runs

runners.name: Kilkee Bay
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming in opening two chase starts before taking a big step forward at Roscommon (2m6f, yielding to soft) to shed his maiden tag convincingly off 90 under today's rider following the reapplication of blinkers; a repeat of that will see him go very close, but overall form suggests that is not a sure thing.
runners.comment: Left poor form behind when shedding m'den tag convincingly last time; close with a repeat
runners.owner: Aiden Larkin & John Larkin & Paudie Dowling & Kenneth Fox

runners.name: Temptationinmilan
runners.spotlight: Won a pair of chases for Charles Byrnes, the latest of them over three years ago; not shown much in hunter chases for this yard and weakened when tried in blinkers in a handicap last time.
runners.comment: Dual winner but last success was over three years ago; hasn't shown much in recent runs

runners.name: Schiehallion
runners.spotlight: 0-20 at the age of nine, but broke a poor run of form back from a break when runner-up over 3m at Bellewstown in April (yielding); pulled up next time and was beaten 24l on his chasing debut at Downpatrick in a beginners' last time; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 0-20; beaten 24l on chase bow last time; others make more appeal

runners.name: The Border Boy
runners.spotlight: Just 1-21 over hurdles; posted a decent effort on his second chase start at Tramore in May when running on well to take fourth of ten (2m6f, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: 1-21 over hurdles; okay fourth on second chase start last time; others preferred

runners.name: Amburana
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-4 in point-to-points and winless from nine starts over hurdles; best watched on chase bow.
runners.comment: Reserve; 0-4 in points and winless from nine over hurdles; best watched on chase bow

runners.name: Watty Show
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; well beaten in sole point; didn't show much in maiden hurdles for Gary McGill and similar story in handicaps for this yard; can only be watched on chase debut.
runners.comment: Reserve; well beaten in sole point and poor form over hurdles; chase debutant

runners.name: Ferdia
runners.spotlight: Has run poorly since returning from a huge absence last winter; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Has run poorly since returning from a huge absence last winter; hard to fancy

runners.name: Three Tribes
runners.spotlight: Never a factor in seven hurdle starts; narrow winner of a Ballysteen point-to-point in April; pulled up on handicap chase debut at Limerick, hanging left; an unlikely winner.
runners.comment: Point winner was not a factor in seven hurdle starts; PU on h'cap chase bow latest

runners.name: Robin Elite
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in handicap chases and recent pointing exploits do not bode well.
runners.comment: Has struggled in handicap chases and recent pointing exploits do not bode well

runners.name: My Cullen
runners.spotlight: Maiden was placed in a couple of handicap hurdles for Henrietta Knight last year; poor form in opening three chase runs for this yard and return to hurdles last time didn't help.
runners.comment: M'den has shown poor form for this yard over fences and a hurdle race

races.race_name: Christy Lucey Transport Mares Finale (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Goodgollymissholly
runners.spotlight: Reappeared last month and much improved from debut run for a previous yard in finishing second at Downpatrick; better again to win Roscommon ladies contest early this month under a positive ride (good); can continue progressing.
runners.comment: Much improved since joining Elliott yard, winning at Roscommon recently; big player

runners.name: Mistakenforanother
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred daughter of Free Eagle showed nice bit of improvement on second start when runner-up at Kilbeggan last month (good-to-yielding); didn't run to same level at Wexford, though, hanging left in straight; more needed.
runners.comment: Kilbeggan runner-up hung left when not as effective at Wexford; more needed

runners.name: Land Me Safe
runners.spotlight: Footstepsinthesand sister to bumper winner Walk On The Beach; dam unraced sister to useful 2m4f hurdler/chaser Go All The Way; justified favouritism on debut in Limerick mares' bumper in late May (soft), asserting late on despite taking a hold early on; interesting prospect, quicker ground to contend with here.
runners.comment: Limerick debut winner on soft; interesting prospect, quicker ground to contend with here

runners.name: Echoes Of Jane
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in point-to-points and on bumper debut last month at Listowel (hooded) over 2m4f (yielding); more needed.
runners.comment: Promise on last month's Listowel bumper debut; more needed

runners.name: Thelittleredfox
runners.spotlight: Jet Away half-sister to winners Exciting Oscar (3m hurdle) and Chasing Unicorn (bumper); dam unraced half-sister to smart 2m-3m hurdle winner Kilfenora; another newcomer likely best watched, unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Half-sister to winners Exciting Oscar (hurdle) and Chasing Unicorn (bumper); market guide

runners.name: Annie's Door
runners.spotlight: Belardo mare cost 3,000euros as a foal; half-sister to winners Female Approach (11.4f/1m4f) and New Star (Qatari 7.5f-1m2f); dam placed 7f 2yo; unlikely type to make an immediate impact.
runners.comment: Cheaply bought half-sister to a couple of minor flat winners; best watched on debut

runners.name: Camille Monfort
runners.spotlight: Mild promise in two point-to-points in the spring for William Codd; debuts for new yard and worth a market check.
runners.comment: Mild promise in two points' for William Codd; debuts for new yard and worth a market check

runners.name: Killeedy
runners.spotlight: Jukebox Jury mare is sister to bumper/2m2f hurdle winner Korinthia; dam bumper winner, sister to bumper/2m4f hurdle winners Baker's Bridge and Backtothekingsnest; top trainer/rider combination and yard have won three of last four renewals, so demands utmost respect.
runners.comment: Yard has won 3 of last 4 renewals so demands utmost respect on debut

runners.name: Shireen Murphy
runners.spotlight: Mount Nelson mare cost 4,000euros as a 3yo; half-sister to 2m3f chase winner Opechee; dam placed 2m/2m2f hurdles, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Sobers; newcomer likely best watched.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 2m3f chase winner Opechee; newcomer likely best watched

runners.name: Unquite Dreams
runners.spotlight: Looked raw on both runs over the winter, plenty green in Cork bumper and too keen when remote fourth in Limerick mares maiden hurdle; tongue-tied now fitted and encounters much quicker ground.
runners.comment: Looked raw on both runs over the winter; tongue-tied now fitted and much quicker ground

runners.name: Taking It Handy
runners.spotlight: Sholokhov filly cost 7,500euros as a foal; third foal; dam unraced half-sister to high-class bumper and 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase winner No More Heroes, family high-class jumpers Celestial Gold and Fiveforthree; debutante worth a market check.
runners.comment: From a smart jumping family; debutante worth a market check

runners.name: Kilbarry Alexy
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to bumper winner Tim Toe; dam unraced half-sister to useful hurdle/chase winner Abolitionist, out of half-sister to high-class jumper Racing Demon; picked up useful experience when third in an academy hurdle at Naas in December, but following month far too keen and paid the price in Cork bumper; has to settle better and back from sixth months' break; encouraging jockey booking.
runners.comment: Far too keen at Cork; has to settle better and back from sixth months' break
runners.owner: Mrs Con O'Keeffe & Tadhg O'Sullivan & Anthony O'Keeffe

runners.name: Royal Tiara
runners.spotlight: Getaway half-sister to winners Rioga Choice (useful 2m hurdle), Its Gonnahappen (2m hurdle) and Special John (3m/3m2f chase); dam 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner; never sighted on Limerick debut in late March on soft; better ground may suit, but can only be watched.
runners.comment: Never sighted on Limerick debut in March on soft; better ground may suit but best watched

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB)

runners.name: Bated Benevolence
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Nottingham (6f, good) in May but found the move up to Group class a step too far when down the field in the Albany Stakes at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month; she should find this company more to her liking on first AW start and should run well.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut at Nottingham in May but outclassed at Royal Ascot.

runners.name: Sequel Star
runners.spotlight: 6-1, made up ground from the rear to finish fourth of ten on her debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month; this looks easier for AW debut.
runners.comment: Made up ground from the rear to finish fourth of ten on her debut at Newbury last month.

runners.name: Roosike
runners.spotlight: 28-1 when third of five on her debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; steps back in trip on her AW debut; should run well.
runners.comment: 28-1 when third of five on her debut at Newbury last month; should run well

runners.name: Expensive Luxury
runners.spotlight: 18,000gns foals; 29,000gns yearlings; fourth foal; by Mohaather; half-sister to 7f AW/7.4f turf 2yo winner Liberty Bird (RPR 72); dam German 7f Listed winner (95), out of maiden half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Screen Star (dam of Cheveley Park winner Lumiere); yard is having plenty of juvenile winners and market should be best guide on this debut.
runners.comment: Yard is having plenty of juvenile winners and market should be best guide on this debut.

runners.name: Veruca Salt
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; third foal; by Harry Angel; half-sister to winners Havana Blast (5f AW 2yo; RPR 90) and Argy Bhaji (5f; 75); dam 5f winner (67), closely related to 5f winner Sitar, out of unraced half-sister to Group 1 winners Airwave (Cheveley Park) and Jwala (Nunthorpe); plenty of speed in her pedigree; wears tongue-tie on debut; betting watch advised.
runners.comment: Plenty of speed in her pedigree; wears tongue-tie on debut; betting watch advised.

runners.name: Leading Raya
runners.spotlight: 250-1 when tailed off on her Windsor debut (6f, good to soft) last month.
runners.comment: 250-1 when tailed off on her Windsor debut last month.

runners.name: Khazamh
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns breeze-up buy; well beaten in a couple of maidens; more needed on AW debut.
runners.comment: 20,000gns breeze-up buy; well beaten in a couple of maidens; more needed on AW debut.

runners.name: Hoosier
runners.spotlight: Slow to start when fifth of six on her debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm; second favourite) last month; will be wiser on this AW debut and likely to show more.
runners.comment: Second favourite, slow to start when fifth of six on her debut at Wetherby last month.

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: Veil Of Clouds
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise in her three novices and may not have got home over 7f last time; sports first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut and has scope to show improvement; claims.
runners.comment: Has shown promise in her three novices and may not have got home over 7f last time.

runners.name: Veydari
runners.spotlight: Has done all of his racing on turf bar one run at Newcastle in 2024; made a most encouraging return from an eight-month break when runner-up at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; should go close if able to reproduce that effort back on AW.
runners.comment: Made an encouraging return from a break when runner-up at Pontefract last month.

runners.name: Monsieur Kodi
runners.spotlight: Has nine career wins, the most recent at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February off 2lb lower; should be better for his fourth of eight at Lingfield (6f, soft) last month and has won off 8lb higher when in his prime; not out of this.
runners.comment: Has nine career wins, the most recent at Lingfield in February off 2lb lower.

runners.name: Red Snapper
runners.spotlight: Sole success came at Bath (5f, heavy) last October; shapes as though this return to 6f will suit but this is tough on AW debut.
runners.comment: Sole success came at Bath last October; shapes as though this return to 6f will suit.

runners.name: Hierarchy
runners.spotlight: Scored off 2lb lower at Lingfield (6f, AW) in February and ran his best race since when fourth of seven at Ffos Las (6f, good) last month; not out of this.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in February; fair fourth at Ffos Las last month.

runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; made all to win over 6f at Lingfield in January; similar form when third over 6f there the following month; gelded since disappointing over 5f in March; needs to be back to his best here.
runners.comment: Prominent racer; made all to win over 6f at Lingfield in January.

runners.name: Nebbia
runners.spotlight: Runner-up for the second time at Leicester (5f, good) last month and should be suited by stepping back up in trip; should run well.
runners.comment: Runner-up for the second time at Leicester last month; steps back up in trip.

runners.name: Obsidian Verse
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form when getting off the mark at Southwell (6f, AW) in April; never figured when fifth of nine at Leicester (6f, good) last month; not one to give up on.
runners.comment: Scored at Southwell in April but only fifth at Leicester last month.

runners.name: Akabusi
runners.spotlight: Has an inconsistent profile but scored off just 1lb lower at Newmarket (6f, good) in May; cannot be ruled out.
runners.comment: Has an inconsistent profile but scored off just 1lb lower at Newmarket in May.

runners.name: Twilight Madness
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D in December off 2lb lower and landed his tenth career win at Bath (5f, good) in April; last of eight though over C&D when last seen and vulnerable to younger rivals.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in December and landed his tenth career win at Bath in April.
runners.owner: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd

runners.name: Yachtsman
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Windsor (6f, good) in May and race may have come too soon when running flat three days later; still unexposed and may be worth another chance after a short break.
runners.comment: Won at Windsor in May and race may have come too soon when running flat three days later.

runners.name: Fifty Nifty
runners.spotlight: Useful 3yo for Tom Clover but has gone backwards since; sold for 2,000gns to join current yard this month; risks involved in yet another change of headgear on stable debut.
runners.comment: Useful 3yo for Tom Clover but has gone backwards since; stable debut.

runners.name: King Of Chaos
runners.spotlight: Has been kept busy and scored for the second time this year when successful over C&D last month off 6lb lower; not disgraced in better company at Epsom eight days ago but may need to come back down the weights.
runners.comment: Scored for the second time this year when successful over C&D last month off 6lb lower.

runners.name: Korbut
runners.spotlight: Has finished runner-up three times, latest at Kempton (7f) 15 days ago; she sets the benchmark here and wears first-time cheekpieces; looks sure to go close.
runners.comment: Has finished runner-up three times, latest at Kempton 15 days ago.

runners.name: One Of The Boys
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to his second run when an encouraging third of nine at Kempton (7f, AW) 15 days ago; should be spot on and is one to keep on side.
runners.comment: Gelded prior to his second run when an encouraging third at Kempton 15 days ago.

runners.name: Pink Pyjamas
runners.spotlight: 22,000euros yearling; sixth foal; by Mohaather; half-sister to four winners including Ingleby Ivy (6f 2yo; RPR 78), Threatlevelmidnite (US 5f-6f including AW) and Shoot The Moon (German 7f); dam 6f turf 2yo/7f AW winner (81); related to a few winners but likely to need this first run.
runners.comment: Related to a few winners but likely to need this first run.

runners.name: Carnival Of Light
runners.spotlight: Showed only modest form in a couple of 1m novices on turf last month; steps back in trip on AW debut and improvement required.
runners.comment: Showed only modest form in a couple of 1m novices on turf last month.

runners.name: Poets Praise
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in a couple of maidens on turf last autumn; this is her first run since and the market will be best guide on this AW debut.
runners.comment: Showed promise in a couple of maidens on turf last autumn.

runners.name: Extended Credit
runners.spotlight: 85,000gns yearling; fifth foal; by Lope Y Fernandez; closely related to 6f/7f winner Dubai Poet (including Australian Listed; RPR 110); dam 6f winner (90), closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Air Chief Marshall, half-sister to 1m6f Group 1 winner Flag Of Honour; makes debut and any market move should be noted.
runners.comment: Makes debut and any market move should be noted.

runners.name: Time Alone
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros foal; sixth foal; by Lucky Vega; half-brother to winners Secret Time (French/US Group-placed 7f; RPR 99) and Sabiano (French/German 9.5f-1m3f); dam 6f 2yo winner (86), sister to Group-placed 7f 2yo winner Caprella, out of 5f/6f winner; sports tongue-tie on debut and best watched for now.
runners.comment: Sports tongue-tie on debut and best watched for now.

runners.name: Rua Mor
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; has shown fair form over hurdles; well beaten in a couple of similar contests over around 1m here; likely to fare better when going handicapping.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a couple of similar contests over around 1m here.

runners.name: Ridger
runners.spotlight: Last of six in a Brighton maiden (6f, good to firm) on debut last month; has been gelded and wears first-time hood stepping up in trip on this AW debut; more required.
runners.comment: Last of six in a Brighton maiden on debut last month.

runners.name: Sonbelievable
runners.spotlight: Has shown only modest form so far, including when ninth of 12 over C&D last month; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Has shown only modest form so far, including when ninth over C&D last month.

runners.name: Cullinan Wolf
runners.spotlight: Last of eight on belated debut at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago and needs to step up considerably on AW debut up in trip.
runners.comment: Last of eight on belated debut at Doncaster three weeks ago.

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Show Me Gold
runners.spotlight: Showed much improved form when making a winning handicap debut at Kempton (7f, AW) last month despite not getting a clear run; 4lb higher but there should be more to come from her and she holds solid claims.
runners.comment: Showed much improved form when making a winning handicap debut at Kempton last month.

runners.name: Searchingtheblues
runners.spotlight: Hasn't gone on since winning her first two starts in 2024; yet to win a handicap and despite a declining mark others are preferred.
runners.comment: Hasn't gone on since winning her first two starts in 2024.

runners.name: Moostar
runners.spotlight: Fairly consistent sort; ran up to her best when runner-up here (6f) 11 days ago; first-time hood replaces visor and good chance that stepping back up in trip can eke out further improvement.
runners.comment: Fairly consistent sort; ran up to her best when runner-up here 11 days ago.

runners.name: Molly Mac
runners.spotlight: 0-12 and and already with her fourth trainer, she nevertheless ran her best race to date when runner-up here (6f) ten days ago; steps back up in trip and shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Ran her best race to date when runner-up here ten days ago.

runners.name: Court Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Kempton (7f, AW) in May off 3lb lower; has run respectably since and the return to her winning distance is a plus.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Kempton in May off 3lb lower; has run respectably since.

runners.name: Hamaleel
runners.spotlight: Scored at Kempton (1m, AW) in January and has been consistent since but is 6lb higher than her winning mark so needs more.
runners.comment: Scored at Kempton in January and has been consistent since.

runners.name: Fizzy Cristal
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over 6f on Newcastle's AW; not in the same form on turf since; steps up in trip back on AW and cannot be discounted.
runners.comment: Both wins have come over 6f on Newcastle's AW; not in the same form on turf since.

runners.name: Eazy On The Eye
runners.spotlight: Both wins came at this track at around 1m in autumn 2024; placed a couple of times in March on AW but below that form on turf twice since; may do better back on AW.
runners.comment: Placed a couple of times in March on AW but below that form on turf twice since.

runners.name: So Sassy
runners.spotlight: Looked one to keep on the right side of when sweeping through late to win at Lingfield last summer (6f, AW); generally held her form since and she is now 2lb below her winning mark; she's a key player, albeit she could do with them going hard early.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield last summer; held her form since and is now 2lb below her winning mark.

runners.name: Zarinca
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark in a Southwell maiden (6f, AW) in April but disappointing in a couple of turf handicaps since; needs to bounce back to her best returning to AW and stepping back up in trip.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Southwell in April but disappointing back on turf since.

runners.name: Pickersgill
runners.spotlight: Secured her first AW win at Southwell (7f) in April; runner-up back there (7f) 12 days ago; needs things to drop right given hold-up tactics are employed; holds decent claims if they do.
runners.comment: Secured her first AW win at Southwell in April; runner-up back there 12 days ago.

runners.name: Chapter
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly at Kempton last August in his only AW race; resumed progress with his turf form on latest outing, winning a 12-runner handicap at Sandown (1m2f, good) five weeks ago when 40-1 in first-time blinkers; up 4lb but that was a warm race and he'll go well if this surface proves no impediment.
runners.comment: Won a warm race at Sandown (1m2f, good) five weeks ago when 40-1 in first-time blinkers

runners.name: Go Rimbaud
runners.spotlight: Fine family; no great improvement this term for his maiden win at Kempton (1m, AW) on return, making all as 6-4 favourite, before a respectable show when fifth of eight on handicap debut at Haydock (1m, good to firm; joint favourite) later in April; gelded since and needs overall improvement.
runners.comment: Kempton maiden win (1m, AW); respectable 5th of eight on handicap debut at Haydock; gelded

runners.name: On The Inlet
runners.spotlight: Readily won on Tapeta (1m/7f) in April in his first two handicaps, latterly at this track; well beaten on turf next time, before a respectable fifth of 13 at Kempton (7f) back on AW; may need to resume improvement.
runners.comment: Has won here; respectable fifth of 13 at Kempton (7f) when back on AW for latest outing

runners.name: Brocklesby Bill
runners.spotlight: Hooded all starts; won a Chepstow maiden (7f, good) in May on second outing and similar form when second in a Windsor novice (1m, good to firm) last time; better is needed on this handicap/AW debut but early days.
runners.comment: 1st and 2nd on last two starts; better is needed on this handicap/AW debut but early days

runners.name: Gentle Warrior
runners.spotlight: Has three wins on turf but has gone off the boil on his last two starts; swaps a visor for first-time cheekpieces on AW debut; not out of this but new headgear needs to have an impact.
runners.comment: Has gone off the boil on his last two starts but new headgear might have an impact.

runners.name: Arcturus Flame
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in April 2025 when trained by Darryl Holland; has performed with credit on several occasions since, resulting in him being still 6lb higher than his winning mark; place claims.
runners.comment: Sole success came in April 2025; has performed with credit on several occasions since.

runners.name: Dance Time
runners.spotlight: All six wins have come on AW but she is still 3lb above her last winning mark; her recent third at Carlisle (1m6f, good) was encouraging but she needs to step up more to win again.
runners.comment: All six wins have come on AW but she is still 3lb above her last winning mark.

runners.name: St Mawes
runners.spotlight: Won back to back over 2m for Emma Lavelle last autumn and ran well to make the frame despite racing freely in a couple of Goodwood handicaps in May; one wonders if the drop back in trip will play to his strengths on stable debut but he makes greater appeal than most of these.
runners.comment: Ran well to make the frame despite racing freely in a couple of Goodwood handicaps in May.

runners.name: Scottish Anthem
runners.spotlight: Both wins came in 2022 when trained in France; returns to the Flat for the first time this year after a couple of runs over hurdles; down to a career-low mark and has had wind surgery but others are preferred.
runners.comment: Both wins in 2022 when trained in France; down to a career-low mark but others preferred.

runners.name: Cabrera
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since landing a Doncaster novice in July 2024 but has been fairly consistent in handicaps; out of her depth in a Listed contest at Pontefract last time but should run her race here.
runners.comment: Hasn't won since winning at Doncaster in 2024 but has been fairly consistent in handicaps.

runners.name: Mersea Island
runners.spotlight: Progressive last year, with the second of his two AW wins coming over C&D in December; this is his first run of the year but he has to be of interest.
runners.comment: Progressive last year, with the second of his two AW wins coming over C&D in December.

runners.name: Heathen
runners.spotlight: Of his five AW wins, two have come at this track, one over today's distance; respectable third at Chester (2m, good) on his reappearance in May but needs to be at the top of his game here as he is 5lb above his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Of his five AW wins, two have come at this track, one over today's distance.

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap

runners.name: Applesandpears
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on the AW last backend (Polytrack, Tapeta) and holds claims switched back from turf judged on either of her recent Carlisle efforts (among the favourites for a Listed race last time); yard among the winners lately too, which is a bonus.
runners.comment: Among the favourites for Listed race last time; player for a yard among the winners lately

runners.name: Bone Marra
runners.spotlight: Currently 3-3 on Tapeta, 0-5 on turf and Polytrack combined; can't be any complaints about a 2lb rise for his Southwell win four weeks ago and he won't mind coming back up from 6f; holds leading claims.
runners.comment: Currently 3-3 on Tapeta; won't mind coming back up from 6f; holds leading claims

runners.name: Hungarian
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far in a couple of sales races last autumn; not as good in two runs back, getting turned over at odds-on round Redcar before not seeing out 8.6f here early last month, and will need plenty more on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Not as good in two runs back and will need plenty more on this handicap debut

runners.name: Espona Bay
runners.spotlight: Won a less competitive C&D handicap off 2lb lower in May; again inclined to over-race when upped to 1m on turf at Windsor last time, which was another solid effort all things considered but he's vulnerable to improvers in this better race.
runners.comment: Another solid effort on turf latest but he's vulnerable to improvers in this better race

runners.name: Deluded
runners.spotlight: Three ordinary efforts on turf punctuate four solid efforts on the AW, including when coming away with a subsequent easy winner over C&D off 2lb lower in the spring; may well be dropped in again from this draw and will be happier back up from 6f; one to consider.
runners.comment: Three ordinary efforts on turf punctuate four solid efforts on the AW; one to consider

runners.name: Do Bronxs
runners.spotlight: Highly tried last year; has shown this mark is within range since handicapping this season, including from wide stalls at Chester; again might have been better drawn on this AW debut (dam did her winning for the yard on turf) in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Capable off this mark; might have been better drawn on this AW debut in first headgear

runners.name: Augustus Gloop
runners.spotlight: Absent for almost five months, having been gelded following two lesser efforts (raced exclusively on the AW to date); yard enjoyed a good month thus far and it will be interesting to see how he goes in the market.
runners.comment: Absent for almost five months and gelded; interesting to see how he goes in the market

runners.name: Trust Amy
runners.spotlight: Plenty of racing last year, when finishing well held in two runs on Tapeta; offered a bit more on latest start but still has stamina to prove, having just a second go beyond 6f, and this race is more competitive.
runners.comment: Bit more last time but still has stamina to prove and this race is more competitive

runners.name: Boy Named Sioux
runners.spotlight: 7f Tapeta winner off 4lb lower last backend before two lesser efforts in a hood (pulled hard on one occasion; headgear now comes off); some way down the pecking order on his return from a break.
runners.comment: Two lesser efforts in a hood latterly; some way down the pecking order back from a break
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Guesstimate
runners.spotlight: Dam was a limited maiden and this filly has followed suit thus far; lost a shoe on her handicap debut last time but, while this race is less competitive, she's had plenty of chances now.
runners.comment: Lost a shoe last time but, while this is less competitive, she's had plenty of chances now

runners.name: Hauteluce
runners.spotlight: Needed the experience in one run last winter and fared much better on her Tapeta comeback, when easily beating a subsequent winner in a weak maiden at Wolverhampton (upped to 9.5f; stamina on the dam's side); should have more to offer under the penalty.
runners.comment: Much better to win on her Tapeta comeback; should have more to offer under the penalty

runners.name: Celestial Cen
runners.spotlight: Shaped nicely at a big price on her soft-ground debut early last month and ran to a similar level last time (good; both over this trip); enters calculations on either effort.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level both starts (1m2f); enters calculations on either effort

runners.name: Sax Avoidance
runners.spotlight: 25,000euros yearling whose dam won on the AW at around 1m in France; hood goes on for her debut and the market will be the best guide for a yard that's enjoying a decent summer.
runners.comment: 25,000euros yearling; hood goes on for her debut and the market will be the best guide

runners.name: Sweet Horizon
runners.spotlight: Started a single-figure price for the Wolverhampton maiden won by Hauteluce late last month but blew the start and was never a factor; blinkers are tried after that.
runners.comment: Blew the start and was never a factor behind Hauteluce on debut; blinkers are now tried

races.race_name: EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Gold Reef City
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to the yard's dual 6f 2yo winner Egoli; started among the favourites for a Salisbury novice that's produced winners a month ago; blew the start and was never involved that day but is entitled to improve.
runners.comment: Among the favourites on debut but blew the start and was never involved; can improve

runners.name: Tawakal
runners.spotlight: Yard won this with a debutant in 2023; this 325,000euros Irish breeze-up 2yo, who's a half-brother to two Irish winners, holds a Gimcrack (Group 2) entry and is a likely looking newcomer.
runners.comment: 325,000euros Irish breeze-up 2yo; holds a Group 2 entry and is a likely looking newcomer

runners.name: Halloween Jack
runners.spotlight: First foal of an unraced sister to useful Irish sprinter Son Of Rest; trainer's strike-rate with 2yos is down a touch this season and the market will guide.
runners.comment: First foal of an unraced sister to useful Irish sprinter Son Of Rest; market will guide

runners.name: Whiskey Galore
runners.spotlight: Big price and badly needed the experience on his recent Epsom debut, blowing the start and finishing a remote last of eight; needs a lot more, dropping back from 7f.
runners.comment: Remote last of eight on Epsom debut; needs a lot more, dropping back from 7f

runners.name: Supreme Star
runners.spotlight: Boasts a decent pedigree but started a big price on his C&D debut three weeks ago, when well held having been inclined to pull hard; will need to improve a deal on that.
runners.comment: Big price on C&D debut three weeks ago, when well held; needs to improve a deal on that

races.race_name: When You Wish Upon A Star Race Handicap

runners.name: Merrijig
runners.spotlight: Adaptable regarding ground and tactics; this looks less competitive than the Ffos Las 0-65 in which he finished second last time (hampered; two of these behind) and his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Adaptable regarding ground and tactics; two of these behind latest; his claims are obvious

runners.name: Regally Blonde
runners.spotlight: Made all off 3lb higher here (1m6f) last July; not in the same form this season, including in that same race a fortnight ago, when a long way off the front pair; needs more.
runners.comment: Not in the same form this season; some way off the front pair here last time; needs more
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

runners.name: Simiyann
runners.spotlight: Better expected last time, after two poor efforts and back to the visor from cheekpieces, but ran below market expectations in finishing behind Merrijig; 2lb better off today but has work to do if he's to turn things round.
runners.comment: Below market expectations when finishing behind Merrijig last time; 2lb better off today

runners.name: Oceanides
runners.spotlight: String of poor efforts to date, latterly when a long way behind Merrijig and Simiyann at Ffos Las late last month; would be a shock winner.
runners.comment: String of poor efforts to date; would be a shock winner

runners.name: Al Sayah
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles since last seen on the Flat, going almost two stone up the weights; withdrawn on account of unsuitable (good to firm) ground last summer, which would be a concern, but she's much better treated on the Flat now.
runners.comment: Much better treated on the Flat now; respected if the ground's not too fast

races.race_name: XMA Wish Race "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Who Have Not Won More Than One Race)

runners.name: Slot
runners.spotlight: Neck second at Newcastle (5f, AW) last time rates a clear career best, and a 3lb rise doesn't look prohibitive; yet to see out a galloping 6f completely convincingly, albeit not having yet tried to on going as quick as today's.
runners.comment: Neck second at Newcastle latest (5f) rates a career best; player if lasting 6f better.

runners.name: Rousham
runners.spotlight: Defied usual hard-pulling and hanging traits to win at Redcar in May (7f, good to firm), but held off mid-60s marks since, already headed when stumbling latest; replication of previous novice/maiden 6f form won't do.
runners.comment: A real handful, but still managed a Redcar win in May (7f); headed when stumbling latest.

runners.name: Liquid Cooled
runners.spotlight: Won going away at Newcastle in March (6f, AW) for a perfect start to life in handicaps; refusal to settle and (latest) traffic issues offer excuses since, but less margin for error now stepped up beyond 0-60 class.
runners.comment: Newcastle 6f winner on handicap debut and excuses since; first step beyond 0-60.

runners.name: Black Missile
runners.spotlight: Unimproved for the addition of cheekpieces (retained here nonetheless) at Ripon in May, and wind surgery resorted to since; effectiveness over a galloping 6f yet to be tested, but 2lb lower mark looks competitive judged against the RPR of last autumn's Leicester debut (5f).
runners.comment: Untested over a galloping 6f, but mark looks increasingly tempting; has had wind surgery.

runners.name: Night Mission
runners.spotlight: Podium finishes on all three 2yo novice starts for Mark Rimell, almost holding on at Redcar (6f, good; bumped late); yet to scale those heights in handicaps this term despite starting off on a tolerable mark, traffic not costing him a win latest; hopes rest with change of scenery since.
runners.comment: Yet to replicate last year's peak form, and not unlucky not to win latest; stable debut.

runners.name: Robert Anstruther
runners.spotlight: Stayed on as strongly as any at Windsor latest (6f, good to firm) after a slow start; more galloping test at the trip is a likely plus, and just a case of whether he helps himself sufficiently; eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Staying-on third at Windsor latest after slow start, and this more galloping 6f may suit

runners.name: Whizzy Dizzy
runners.spotlight: A failure under patient tactics aside, she proved consistent last autumn and winter; timely return to 6f judged on recent keeping-on Tapeta runs, but she's still possibly high in the weights despite 1lb more off.
runners.comment: Consistent rather than progressive, but return to 6f looks a plus judged on latest runs.

races.race_name: PKF Wish Race Classified Stakes

runners.name: Washington Heir
runners.spotlight: Much better since switching to classified events, Brighton 6f third on latest start being the form equal of his preceding breakthrough win there (5.5f); offered little on his one run around a galloping track, but it's likely his confidence is far higher now.
runners.comment: Win and equally good third at Brighton since switching to classifieds; confidence high.

runners.name: Sir Benedict
runners.spotlight: All five turf wins have been gained on galloping sprint courses, and he's netted a neck second (off 64) and a win in handicaps from two C&D starts; yet to pick up a classified in nine attempts, however, and not an unlucky loser in one at Southwell latest despite running short of room.
runners.comment: Win and neck second from two C&D visits (handicaps); player, though 0-9 in classifieds.

runners.name: Ganthorpe
runners.spotlight: Breakthrough Carlisle handicap success in May has been flanked by three rather less auspicious efforts, similarly over 6f on good; only one attempt at 5f so far (Tapeta novice stakes at huge odds) but dam and (to Listed level) granddam both scored at this trip.
runners.comment: Carlisle handicap win in May (6f); still largely untried quantity over this shorter trip.

runners.name: Jackie Brown
runners.spotlight: 6f turf and Polytrack scorer for Tony Martin, and demonstrated the benefit of her stable debut outing when third at Ffos Las late last month (6f, good); effectiveness over a bare 5f is untested since October 2024.
runners.comment: Fair third on second outing for current yard latest (6f); not sure return to 5f is a plus.

runners.name: Desert Master
runners.spotlight: Yet to win away from Tapeta, and while June's half-length second in a Doncaster handicap (6f, good to firm) represents his nearest ever miss on turf, it's been diminishing returns from him again since.
runners.comment: Nearest miss yet on turf at Doncaster last month (6f); has gone the wrong way again since.
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner

runners.name: Antiphon
runners.spotlight: Still capable of running up to high-80s RPRs just two years ago, but has offered nothing in two outings this term and remains winless around anywhere as galloping as Nottingham; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Nowhere near the force of two years ago and is more compelling on sharper tracks.

runners.name: Baileys Ontherocks
runners.spotlight: No pickup in fortunes for the recent switch to classified events (including over 6f here) and application of cheekpieces, well held when third on Tapeta latest.
runners.comment: No better latterly for the switch to classified events (one here) or added cheekpieces.

runners.name: Rinky Tinky Tinky
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 16 starts was gained in a 6f handicap here (good to firm) 14 months ago, and marginally her best effort since last August came when returning here last month; still early days for her this term and she's not dismissed lightly.
runners.comment: 6f handicap winner here in 2025 and fared okay over the same C&D latest; possibilities.

runners.name: Captain Kinsella
runners.spotlight: Dual 5f novice winner in December 2024 but well below that form level these days, faring no better with a tongue-tie added when last seen in March (it's retained here); record when returning from a break is mixed.
runners.comment: Operating well below late 2024's novice-winning form level, including tongue tied latest.

races.race_name: Arthur Johnson & Sons Wish Race "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Race In 2026)

runners.name: Goldie Trickett
runners.spotlight: Third at Leicester (good) last time was her most affirmative statement on turf or over 1m2f, as well as being recorded in a fairly well-stocked 0-70; not one for blind faith given her propensity to pull, but this does look an easier opportunity.
runners.comment: Best turf/1m2f form yet in a Leicester 0-70 latest; clear case despite tendency to pull.

runners.name: Revich
runners.spotlight: 10yo who's the sole winner (seven times) in this, if not since autumn 2023, but last two outings at Bath have advertised the need to give him a longer run over 1m2f now; no ground or track issues, and he's among the likeliest.
runners.comment: Near-miss at Bath over 1m2f before outpaced on drop back to 1m there latest; player.

runners.name: Finally Escaped
runners.spotlight: Ignore one outpaced effort dropped to 7f and she's basically been consistent, if not the easiest; racing freely appeared more the issue than today's trip at Doncaster latest (0-75) and she remains of interest off a new career-low mark, assuming she helps herself more this time.
runners.comment: Basically consistent, if not the easiest; may well stay 1m2f, and remains of interest.

runners.name: Brouhaha
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and generally behind on all three 7f-1m starts (fast turf or standard Tapeta), and now switches to handicaps at a realistic level but off no gift of a mark; winners at 5f-1m4f in immediate pedigree.
runners.comment: Slowly away and generally behind in qualifying outings; no chance taken with initial mark.

runners.name: Token Love
runners.spotlight: 0-9; far from his only weak finish when fading back past Revich over 8.5f here in April, and sold out of the Greenall/Guerriero yard for 4,000gns following a similar effort on only run since; last home on sole 1m2f start.
runners.comment: Just behind Revich here in April, but non-stayer of 8.5f that day; stable debut.

runners.name: Nicolai
runners.spotlight: Unable to break out of midfield on any of five Tapeta/Polytrack starts for Jack Channon at up to 8.6f; longer trip is a potential plus given the immediate family is laden with 1m2f winners (many on turf), but cheekpieces need to motivate him more than the visor did; stable debut.
runners.comment: Never better than midfield to date; cheekpieces now tried on turf/stable/1m2f debut.

races.race_name: Joe Mac's Big Retirement Bash Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Rizal
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo who got off the mark at the ninth attempt at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago, prevailing by 3l on his second stable start; kept on for close third over 1m3f on his stable debut and there can be optimism that 1m4f will be within range; strong claims up 7lb for last time.
runners.comment: 3l win over 1m2f last month on second stable start; can be hope 1m4f will be within range

runners.name: Nightsinwhitesatin
runners.spotlight: She remains 5lb higher than for her last win last August but that's because she's been admirably consistent in defeat this year; runner-up at York (1m4f, good to firm) last Friday and she can be bang there.
runners.comment: Admirably consistent in defeat this season and she can be bang there
runners.owner: David Kilburn, Mrs Corbett, Chris Wright

runners.name: Spirit Of Jura
runners.spotlight: Course winner (1m5f, good) who went very close at Ripon (1m4f, good) last month; she was last of five here (1m5f, good) last Saturday but was beaten just under 2l having led at a steady pace, and she's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Went very close at Ripon last month; slightly underwhelming here since but not ruled out

races.race_name: Jordan Electrics EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands A, B, C And D) (EBF Restricted Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Nicely
runners.spotlight: £95,000 breeze-up buy who finished among some pricey recruits when runner-up at 9-1 on recent debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm); that was a promising start and there is every chance that she'll progress; key player.
runners.comment: Runner-up on debut at Nottingham & there is every chance that she'll progress; key player

runners.name: Trumpety Trump
runners.spotlight: £28,000 breeze-up buy who was a close third of four at 33-1 on recent debut at Ayr (6f, good); he's 5lb better off with the runner-up Instant Force and his trainer isn't known for first-time-out 2yo winners, so it was a very encouraging start to his career and he could have lots more to offer.
runners.comment: Close third at 33-1 on recent debut at Ayr and he could have lots more to offer

runners.name: Battle Fever
runners.spotlight: Backed into 11-4 when keeping on for clear second on debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; shaped as though the step up to 6f could be a positive move and he's firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Kept on for clear second over 5f at Beverley on debut and he's firmly in calculations

runners.name: Instant Force
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns breeze-up buy who was sent off the 4-9 favourite when a head second of four on debut at Ayr (6f, good) 12 days ago; Trumpety Trump was half a length behind and is 5lb better off today, but this fellow is open to improvement for his top yard and could play a leading role.
runners.comment: Favourite when close second on recent debut at Ayr; open to improvement for top yard

runners.name: Savoy Blue
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival last month on her first two starts (6f/5f, soft/good to firm), when 20-1 then 50-1; she would be a shock winner today.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival last month on her first two starts, when 20-1 then 50-1

races.race_name: Hamish MacGregor Memorial Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Fern Clyde
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form when getting off the mark at the fourth attempt at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; unsuited by the step up to 7.4f at Beverley since and she could play a leading role back down in trip with a tongue-tie added on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Won 6f maiden at Pontefract last month and unsuited by the step up to 7.4f at Beverley

runners.name: Quiet Soul
