runners.spotlight: Promising second when 33-1 on debut at Southwell (5f, AW) in April and a market check is advised on this first nursery start, but two lesser runs have followed (5f, good to firm/good) and she needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Promising second on debut in April; check betting, but two lesser runs have followed

runners.name: Brandenburg
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to win at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in May on second start and returned from a break with good second at 50-1 on stable debut at York (6f, good to firm) last Saturday; leading claims off the same mark.
runners.comment: 50-1 runner-up on stable debut at York last Saturday; leading claims off the same mark

runners.name: Tango Hotel
runners.spotlight: Improved upon her first two runs (5f, good to soft/good) when winning a five-runner maiden at Ffos Las (5f, soft) last month in first-time cheekpieces (retained) and she did it in good style; second of three in a 5f nursery here yesterday; the step up to 6f seems a likely plus; respected.
runners.comment: Decisive maiden win at Ffos Las last month; second of three in a 5f nursery here yesterday

runners.name: Beauty For Love
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward with 4l third of six at Ayr (6f, soft) on her second start and similar form when sixth of 11, beaten about 3l, at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; not obviously well treated off his opening mark but his pedigree provides optimism that he'll improve.
runners.comment: Not obviously well treated off opening mark but pedigree provides optimism he'll improve

races.race_name: Jordan Electrics Scottish Stewards' Cup Handicap

runners.name: Gangsta Man
runners.spotlight: Got up in the final strides over 5f here (good to firm) three weeks ago on his fourth start for this yard; he could have more to offer for this stable, especially back up in trip with his Irish wins having come at 7.5f/7f; respected up 4lb for last time.
runners.comment: Won here three weeks ago on fourth start for yard and could have more to offer for stable

runners.name: Manila Scouse
runners.spotlight: Running well this year, including a close third here (5f, good) in May, and he posted a deserved win in a big field at Ayr (6f, good) last Monday; this C&D winner is a solid candidate under a 4lb penalty.
runners.comment: C&D winner who scored in a big field at Ayr last Monday; solid candidate under 4lb penalty

runners.name: Sir Garfield
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a win at Catterick (6f, good) in April and then made all at Epsom (6f, good) this month; his stable is a dab hand when it comes to older horses progressing through the ranks and, with the Epsom form having been franked, a 3lb rise could prove lenient for this thriving 5yo.
runners.comment: 2-2 for the year and latest form has been franked; a 3lb rise could prove lenient

runners.name: Ferrous
runners.spotlight: Unraced on turf this year and his best form has come on AW; however, he has a lower mark on grass and was third in a Listed race at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last August; capable of playing a leading role.
runners.comment: Best form has come on AW but he has a lower mark on turf; capable of playing leading role

runners.name: Strike Red
runners.spotlight: 8yo who can be in and out but he won at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in April and has run well in defeat on his last two starts, at Epsom (6f, soft) and Newcastle (6f, AW); he was a close second of 14 last time and this C&D winner can be in the mix if he's once more on a going day.
runners.comment: C&D winner who was a close second on AW last time and could be in the mix

runners.name: Saint Lawrence
runners.spotlight: Having dropped down the weights he was a close second at Ascot (6f, good) in May on his stable/seasonal debut, and perhaps the soft ground didn't suit at Epsom last time; not written off but this 8yo has been regressive and remains without a win since June 2023.
runners.comment: Close second on stable debut; well beaten next time, albeit on soft; winless since 2023

runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.spotlight: 10yo who is winless since August 2024 and needs to improve upon his last few performances; however, he's a nine-time course winner, including this race in 2024, and his reduced mark appeals on form as recent as this May; not discounted.
runners.comment: Needs to improve upon last few efforts but this nine-time course winner is not discounted
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Commanche Falls
runners.spotlight: 9yo whose last win was in September 2023 and it's possible that he'll need this first outing since February; however, he won this in 2021 and showed spark when twice finishing second in Bahrain this January (6f, good/good to firm); not ruled out.
runners.comment: 9yo who hasn't won since 2023 and returns from a break, but showed spark in January
runners.owner: Doug Graham, Ian Davison, Alan Drysdale

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Glasgow Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Prizeland
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW novice winner (1m/1m4f) who was runner-up in the Lingfield Oaks Trial (11.6f, good to firm) before respectable fifth of 15 in the Italian Oaks (10.5f, good); the Lingfield form hasn't worked out but she's nevertheless a leading contender today.
runners.comment: Runner-up in Lingfield Oaks Trial then fifth in Italian Oaks; she's a leading contender

runners.name: Mr Colonel
runners.spotlight: Won Redcar novice (1m2f, good to firm) in April on reappearance before respectable third of five in Group 3 Chester Vase (1m4f, good), behind subsequent Irish Derby winner Benvenuto Cellini; early interference when down the field at Royal Ascot and could have a part to play back down in grade.
runners.comment: 3rd in Chester Vase then suffered early interference at Royal Ascot; may have part to play

runners.name: Plaid
runners.spotlight: Made it two wins from her four starts when easily winning a Class 3 handicap here (1m1f, good) in May; stamina to prove today and she was only fifth in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m2f, soft) last time, but the ground may not have suited and she remains one to be interested in, especially back here.
runners.comment: Impressive in Class 3 handicap here in May; soft ground may not have suited at Goodwood

runners.name: Folk Pageant
runners.spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row in May/June (1m2f/10.3f, good/soft); down the field in Royal Ascot handicap next time and same story there last Friday, so she needs to turn things around, but she's not discounted in view of her previous promise.
runners.comment: Handicap hat-trick in May/June; down the field on both starts since but not discounted
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Superior Choice
runners.spotlight: Built upon the promise of his sole 2yo run to win Leicester maiden (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance, and he followed up in a small-field novice at Newmarket (1m2f, good) last month; today is a much tougher test of his credentials but this blue-blooded colt may well be up to the task.
runners.comment: 2-2 this year; today is much tougher but this blue-blooded colt may well be up to the task

runners.name: Flawless Fusion
runners.spotlight: Five unsuccessful starts for Joseph O'Brien, finishing second in a couple of 2yo maidens; changed hands for 2,500gns this month and she would be a surprise winner on her stable debut, for which a hood is applied.
runners.comment: 0-5 for Joseph O'Brien; sold for 2,500gns; she would be a surprise winner on stable debut

races.race_name: Hamilton Park Celebrates 100 Years Of Racing Handicap

runners.name: Law Of Average
runners.spotlight: Made all twice in a row this spring (including over C&D on good to firm) and bounced back from his third of six at Yarmouth for another front-running win at Lingfield (5f, AW) last Monday; had plenty in hand last time and he's 5lb well in under a 5lb penalty; could prove tough to catch.
runners.comment: He's won three of his last four and is ahead of the handicapper under a 5lb penalty

runners.name: Rock Of England
runners.spotlight: 6yo who has enjoyed a renaissance in 2026, winning twice (5f, AW/good) and posting a close second at Ripon (5f, good) latest; there remains mileage in his mark judged on old form and this course winner is respected.
runners.comment: Two wins this year and close second at Ripon last time; this course winner is respected

runners.name: Justmyluck
runners.spotlight: 3yo who won at Newcastle (5f, AW) in January on his second stable start but slim pickings across his three runs since; upset in stalls and withdrawn at Musselburgh in June (33-1 at the time); wears a first-time hood.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle in January on second stable start but slim pickings subsequently

runners.name: Jm Jhingree
runners.spotlight: Returned to form when making all in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) in a selling handicap over C&D (good to firm) last month; lost a shoe when down the field at Ayr (5f, good to firm) on Monday but this is a hotter race than the one he won here two starts ago and others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Won C&D selling handicap last month; down the field at Ayr since; back up in grade today

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: She's been running well in the main this season and has finished second at Ayr (5f, good/good to firm) on her two starts this month; she's won over C&D and there's every chance that she'll be bang there.
runners.comment: C&D winner who has been runner-up at Ayr on her two starts this month; can be bang there

races.race_name: Hampton By Hilton Hamilton Park Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Stella Lucente
runners.spotlight: 3yo who has finished second or third on all six starts, most recently runner-up at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) 11 days ago in first-time blinkers (retained); she'll be fine back on turf and can again be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: 3yo who has finished second or third on all six starts and can again be in the shake-up

runners.name: Sogniamo
runners.spotlight: 80-1 winner here (1m1f, good to firm) in May on her reappearance and second start; tailed off on handicap debut at Redcar (1m2f, good) since and needs to prove her course win was no fluke, but she's not written off.
runners.comment: 80-1 win here in May on second start; tailed off in handicap since but not written off

runners.name: Second Fiddle
runners.spotlight: Six wins last September-December (including C&D) and she's gone very close to adding to that tally on her last two outings, beaten just a neck over C&D (good) last Saturday despite being badly hampered; lots to like.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck over C&D last Saturday despite being badly hampered; lots to like

runners.name: Geo
runners.spotlight: Won at Ayr (1m, good to firm) in May and she's twice gone close here since, over C&D and at 1m3f; features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Won at Ayr in May & has twice gone close here since; features prominently in calculations

runners.name: Zermatt Star
runners.spotlight: Encouraging debut for Jessica Harrington at Punchestown (1m, good to yielding) last September; however, her form went the wrong way across her next three starts and she was sold for 2,200gns last month; needs to turn things around on her stable debut.
runners.comment: Encouraging debut last September but form went the wrong way; has changed stables

races.race_name: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Cilician
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in novice events at Nottingham (6f, good) and Sandown (7f, good) either side of his midfield finish in the Coventry Stakes at Royal Ascot; sets the standard and should win races but this could be warm.
runners.comment: Runner-up in novices either side of midfield finish in the Coventry at Royal Ascot; chance

runners.name: Force Of Light
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; brother to 6f/7f 2yo winner Shadow Of Light (including 2yo Group 1; RPR 119), closely related to 5.5f-7f winner Earthlight (including 2yo Group 1; 119), half-brother to two winners including Wild Desert (7f 2yo; 105); dam Group-placed 7f 2yo winner (109); looks the part on paper and stable's 2yos operating at a fine strike-rate.
runners.comment: Has two Group 1 2yo winners amongst his siblings; of obvious appeal on paper

runners.name: Arthurian
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-brother to 1m 2yo/9.4f AW winner Crockham Heath (RPR 85); dam French Listed-placed 1m winner (85), half-sister to winners All Rumours (1m2f Listed) and Trachonitus (1m 2yo); Andrew Balding has won this with subsequent Dewhurst winners Gewan (on debut) and Chaldean (second time out) in recent seasons; of obvious interest.
runners.comment: Well-bred colt from a stable that's won this race with high-class 2yos twice recently

runners.name: Rafe's Da Man
runners.spotlight: Second run was more promising than his debut but it would still be surprising if there weren't a few stronger in today's field; stable run three in the race.
runners.comment: Latest Salisbury 4th was promising but another big step forward is needed; yard run three

runners.name: Red Tail
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to smart winners Quick Wit (7f-1m2f) and Gallagher (6f 2yo/7f), out of Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winning half-sister to Gimcrack winner Bannister; stable may hold stronger claims elsewhere.
runners.comment: 20,000gns yearling; unraced dam from useful family; stable hold stronger claims elsewhere

runners.name: Cavalier
runners.spotlight: Clear signs of ability in novice events here (6.5f, good to soft) and Lingfield (7f, AW) this summer; that form will likely need bettering if he is to get off the mark in this field; Richard Hannon runs three here.
runners.comment: Promise in his two novice runs but more will be needed to come out on top  in this field

runners.name: Primal
runners.spotlight: Met all sorts of trouble when sixth on his debut at Nottingham (6f, good; Ciilician second); hot favourite for a 6f Kempton maiden 18 days ago on the strength of it but he could only manage fourth; still has time on his side but Oisin Murphy rides stablemate Arthurian.
runners.comment: Promising debut but turned over at 2-5 on AW since; Oisin Murphy rides his stablemate

runners.name: Golden Eagle
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling, 80,000euros breeze-up 2yo; third foal; dam Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner (RPR 99), half-sister to winners Ocean Tempest (1m Listed) and Mohawk Ridge (1m-2m); one to note for market confidence.
runners.comment: 80,000euros breeze-up 2yo; dam a Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner; worth a market check
runners.owner: Teme Valley, C Rosier & Mrs J Rosier

runners.name: Shoot You Down
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns yearling; third foal; brother to Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner Rochfortbridge (RPR 91), half-brother to 7f AW winner Mapledurham (72); dam unraced half-sister to US 7f Grade 1 winner First Defence, out of US 7f Grade 1 winner; good pedigree and one to note for market confidence.
runners.comment: 400,000gns brother to Listed-placed 2yo winner Rochfortbridge (RPR 91); check the betting

runners.name: Clive The Writer
runners.spotlight: 27,000euros foal, 28,000euros yearling; third foal; half-brother to winners Akvarel (Polish 5f-1m including 2yo) and Argon Flash (Italian 7f/7.5f); dam made frame 10.5f-12.5f in France, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Coral Beach; stable house an exciting 2yo prospect, who made a winning debut, so worth a market check.
runners.comment: 28,000euros yearling; stable have had a winning 2yo newcomer this year; check betting

runners.name: Revoked
runners.spotlight: 85,000euros yearling; fourth foal; brother to 7f 2yo winner Major Neigh Sayer (RPR 86); dam placed 1m2f-1m4f (79), half-sister to 6f/7f 2yo Group 1 winner Dabirsim; should have a future but this looks a tough starting point.
runners.comment: 85,000euros yearling; brother to a 7f 2yo winner; this looks a tough starting point

runners.name: Grapple
runners.spotlight: 32,000gns yearling; fourth foal; closely related to Swedish 1m/8.6f winner Showgal, half-brother to winners Orchard Keeper (1m2f/1m6f; RPR 99) and The Hrse Horse (Qatari 7f); dam unraced half-sister to Group 3 winners Best Name (1m2f) and February Sun (1m3f); stable in fine form but others have more appealing pedigrees.
runners.comment: 32,000gns yearling with three winning siblings; yard in form; others make greater appeal

runners.name: Extended Order
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f maiden at Brighton (good to firm) on debut in May; well-beaten last at Kempton (7f) 18 days ago and surprising if he could overcome his penalty in this company.
runners.comment: 6f maiden win on debut but remote last on AW (7f) since; opposable under penalty

runners.name: Fuel The Jet
runners.spotlight: Market mover prior to his debut at Thirsk (7f, good) in May, a race where he shaped nicely; he will need a good step forward to come out on top here though.
runners.comment: Market mover & shaped with promise on May's debut at Thirsk (7f, good); this requires more

races.race_name: Boost Tokens Now Live At BetVictor EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Next Of Kin
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo winner (including AW; RPR 100), closely related to 6f/7f winner William Dewhirst, half-sister to Italian Listed-placed 7.5f/1m1f winner Crook; enough paper appeal to warrant a market check.
runners.comment: Dam a Group-placed 2yo winner; powerful stable; the betting should be revealing

runners.name: Lady Of Hay
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Anna Swan (Listed-placed 7f 2yo; RPR 90) and Dark Shore (Qatari 1m2f); dam Group-placed 7f-1m2f winner (including 2yo; 106), sister to German/UAE 1m6f Group 3 winner Ispolini; bred to need more of a test but she represents powerful connections and a market check is advised.
runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of useful mare; bred to stay further but worth market check

runners.name: Marsala
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to connections' useful Palmar Bay; encouraging start to her career when fourth of 13 over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and she is open to improvement; high on the list.
runners.comment: Promising fourth over C&D on debut 15 days ago; open to improvement; high on the list

runners.name: Faith In Florence
runners.spotlight: Smart pedigree; made a promising debut when fourth of ten in a fillies' maiden at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; should do much better; respected.
runners.comment: Smart pedigree and made a pleasing start at Yarmouth last month; can do much better

runners.name: Al Samsama
runners.spotlight: 70,000euros foal, 145,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Utxa (French 1m1f 2yo/Czech 1m3f) and Sopran Beethoven (Italian 6f); dam once-raced close relative of 6f/7f Listed winner Rose Bonheur, out of 1m Group 3 winner; William Buick booked; one to consider.
runners.comment: 145,000gns half-sister to two winners in Europe; William Buick booked; one to consider

runners.name: Lady Henshaw
runners.spotlight: £52,000 yearling, 90,000euros breeze-up 2yo; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Manhattan Jungle (French 5f 2yo/US 6.5f Listed; RPR 95), She's A Warrior (1m; 89), Gregory Ligh (Italian 8.7f) and Raccontero Di Te (prolific Italian 5f/6f); dam 1m AW 2yo winner (59); hooded for debut; another to monitor closely in the betting.
runners.comment: 90,000euros breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to 4 winners; hooded for debut; check the betting

runners.name: Sarasota Blue Blue
runners.spotlight: 175,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Manatee Mehmas (5f; RPR 95) and Tiva (5f; 86); dam placed 6f (including 2yo; 71), closely related to 6f Group 2 winner Tasleet and Group-placed 6f 2yo winner Aspect Island; yard seeking first 2yo winner of the year but she's of interest on paper.
runners.comment: 175,000gns half-sister to two winners; likely type on paper; yard 0-11 with 2yos in 2026

runners.name: Windmill
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam a maiden (RPR 62) half-sister to a German Listed winner;  perhaps one for the longer term.
runners.comment: Dam a maiden half-sister to a Listed winner in Germany; perhaps one for the longer term

runners.name: Wig Wam Bam
runners.spotlight: 92,000gns foal, 100,000gns yearling; first foal of an unraced half-sister to winners Galmarley (useful 1m5f) and Gallifrey (1m 2yo/12.4f), out of 1m Listed winner from family of Derby runner-up Walk In The Park; may need more of a test in time.
runners.comment: 100,000gns yearling; unraced dam from a good staying family; may need more of a test

runners.name: Takaaful
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (including Group 3; RPR 102), half-sister to Group-placed 5f-7.4f winner Motafaawit, out of 6f 2yo winning half-sister to 7f Listed winner Mankib; another well-bred newcomer who requires a market check.
runners.comment: Dam a Group 3 winner from a good family; another well-bred newcomer to note in the market

runners.name: Virtue Humble
runners.spotlight: 7,000gns foal, 32,000gns yearling; first foal; dam unraced sister to winners Monaasib (Group-placed 6f/6.4f 2yo) and Just A Girl (7.6f 2yo), half-sister to 5f Listed winner Tarboosh, out of 6f Listed winner; likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: 32,000gns yearling; some appeal on paper but likely best watched in this field

runners.name: Lilywhite Hart
runners.spotlight: 66-1 for her debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month when showing some ability but ultimately finishing well beaten; likely  a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: Shaped with some promise but ultimately well beaten on Windsor debut; longer-term prospect

runners.name: Phillipa
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and never in the hunt at Windsor (6f, good to soft) on last month's debut; big leap forward needed.
runners.comment: Slowly away and never in the hunt at Windsor (6f, good to soft) on last month's debut

races.race_name: Apple Print & Creative Rose Bowl Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: A Bear Affair
runners.spotlight: Won the Brocklesby in March; ran well at Royal Ascot (sixth of 25) and showed better form when second of eight in a Listed race at Sandown (5f, good; Ronson and Underdog in behind) two weeks ago; return to 6f should suit; respected.
runners.comment: Strong at the finish when 2nd in 5f Listed race latest; return to 6f can help; respected
runners.owner: A Bit On The Side & Partner

runners.name: Nabati
runners.spotlight: 850,000gns yearling; unextended when landing odds of 2-9 in a four-runner maiden at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; this is a much sterner test of his credentials but no surprise to see him in the thick of it.
runners.comment: Barely broke sweat when winning 4-runner maiden on debut; this tougher but could be smart

runners.name: Social Symbol
runners.spotlight: Ready win at Ripon (5f, good) on debut; finished fastest when fourth of 21 in the Norfolk Stakes four weeks ago; 6f looks sure to suit and he retains considerable potential.
runners.comment: Debut win was followed by a fast-finishing fourth at Royal Ascot; 6f will suit; promising

runners.name: Sale Shark
runners.spotlight: Impressed when winning a maiden at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in May; confirmed he was a promising juvenile by finishing fifth in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), doing best of those racing on the unfavoured far side; capable of better still and he's a major player.
runners.comment: Impressed on debut before doing best of the far-side group at Royal Ascot; strong claims

runners.name: God Given Talent
runners.spotlight: Won well over C&D (good) on his debut in May; 25-1 and well beaten in the Coventry Stakes last month; still has time to do better but others bring more compelling credentials.
runners.comment: C&D win on debut; struggled at Royal Ascot and others bring more compelling claims

runners.name: Arapaho Gold
runners.spotlight: Well found in the market prior to his winning debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) in May; played up in the stalls before being withdrawn at Beverley four weeks later; easily justified 2-9 favouritism back at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago and he's a promising juvenile; well worth his place in this higher grade.
runners.comment: 2-2 at Thirsk, looking a useful prospect; well worth his place in this higher grade

runners.name: Agamemnon
runners.spotlight: All runs at 5f, winning an AW novice in May before a creditable eighth in the Group 2 Norfolk Stakes at the Royal meeting; 6f should suit; not fully exposed.
runners.comment: AW novice win before a solid effort in Group 2 company latest; 6f should suit; unexposed

runners.name: Severn Councils
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Online Alexander (useful 5f including 2yo) and Bnedel (1m 2yo/10.4f), out of 7f winning half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Red Clubs; stiff task on debut; stable also run Agamemnon.
runners.comment: 120,000euros yearling; unraced dam from a speedy family; stiff task on debut

runners.name: Underdog
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f novice at Sandown on debut; he has finished behind reopposing rivals in two runs since and others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: 5f novice win on debut; has finished behind reopposing rivals on his last two starts

runners.name: Kamaal
runners.spotlight: 3l behind God Given Talent over C&D on debut; 200-1 when appearing to excel himself in the Coventry Stakes, beaten just over 4l into tenth; remains capable of better.
runners.comment: Ran a cracker when an unconsidered 200-1 shot in the Coventry Stakes; can do better

races.race_name: Bet On The Open With BetVictor Handicap

runners.name: Starlight Sami
runners.spotlight: Placed on four occasions prior to his 7f handicap win at Salisbury in May; that form has worked out well enough to think this mark was in range and his disappointing run here 24 days ago can be excused (lost his position after some early scrimmaging); has to prove his stamina but he will be a danger to all if seeing out the mile.
runners.comment: Salisbury win is solid form; had an excuse here last month; big chance if staying the trip

runners.name: Luminare
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo; improved efforts when in the frame in turf handicaps at Lingfield and over C&D on her last two starts; no obvious reason why she wouldn't give her running again.
runners.comment: Two good runs in turf handicaps this summer, the latest over C&D; in the mix once more

runners.name: Areti
runners.spotlight: Ran as well as she ever has when fourth of 14 on her handicap debut at Southwell (1m, AW) 12 days ago; each-way prospects off the same mark.
runners.comment: 0-7 but she ran well on her handicap debut and holds each-way claims once again

runners.name: Lightning Glory
runners.spotlight: Promise in maiden/novice events and she ran well for second (of 14; Areti fourth) on her handicap debut at Southwell 12 days ago; 3lb well in and she remains capable of better.
runners.comment: Good second on recent handicap debut (1m, AW); 3lb well in and capable of better
runners.owner: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi

runners.name: Rajiba
runners.spotlight: Improved her RPR with each of her three runs in AW maiden/novice events (6f-8.6f); Oisin Murphy takes over for her handicap debut and further progress could be on the cards.
runners.comment: Improved with each of her three runs so far and may do so again now handicapping

runners.name: Accademia
runners.spotlight: May have needed the run when down the field on her seasonal/handicap debut in May; took a good step forward with her win at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 7lb and stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust but she still has time on her side.
runners.comment: Big step forward with 7f win at Doncaster two weeks ago; up 7lb and stamina not assured

runners.name: Pierpoint
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three fillies' events from 7f-1m2f; open to improvement now handicapping but she will require a good leap forward.
runners.comment: Not obviously well treated on her form in maiden/novice events; this more suitable though

runners.name: Berlinetta
runners.spotlight: Consistent rather than progressive in five runs over sprint trips for William Haggas; returns from 172 days off for Jack Channon (same owners) with a point to prove, not least her stamina.
runners.comment: No progress in 5 sprint runs for William Haggas; new trainer quick to step her up in trip

runners.name: Name The Day
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut (6f, good to firm) but she was easy to back and ran poorly on AW on her second run; back to form with a 7f novice win at Chepstow two weeks ago but that form isn't easy to quantify with the form horses failing to give their running; not bred to need this far but shapes as though it's worth a try.
runners.comment: 7f win at Chepstow came in a modest novice; not bred to need this far but likely to stay

runners.name: Majd Al Kazem
runners.spotlight: Absent since a low-key nursery debut at Newmarket (7f, good) 268 days ago; gelded prior to his return; improvement essential for today's step up in trip.
runners.comment: Absent since low-key nursery debut nine months ago; been gelded; returns over a new trip

races.race_name: Uhy Ross Brooke Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Green Sky
runners.spotlight: Modest form under both codes for David Pipe; she has proved a different proposition since joining Rod Millman, running away with a small-field Class 5 at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) two weeks ago and making light of her penalty at York (1m4f, good to firm) last week; didn't look straightforward under pressure there but she was well on top at the finish and Oisin Murphy replaces an apprentice today; 7lb ahead of her mark and she's a major player.
runners.comment: 2-2 for new yard (1m4f, good to firm); 7lb well in; lots to like with O Murphy taking over

runners.name: Koala Rose
runners.spotlight: She has hit the frame in each of her three runs in maiden/novice company, recording best form when second of ten in a 1m6f event at Goodwood four weeks ago; the front pair pulled 12l clear of the third on that occasion and she moves into handicaps with untapped potential.
runners.comment: Progressive form in maiden/novice events; open to further progress now handicapping

runners.name: Aphrodite Spirit
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo; won a 1m2f maiden on AW last September; weak in the betting prior to her seasonal/handicap debut here (1m2f, good to firm) last month, a race where she plugged on for third; stepping up in trip could unlock more from her but it will need to.
runners.comment: Encouraging return here (1m2f) last month; new trip may help but improvement is needed

races.race_name: Crossland Employment Solicitors Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Turty Tree
runners.spotlight: Didn't look straightforward when the race got serious on last two outings but he was nevertheless better at keeping a straight line when cheekpieces were enlisted for six-runner maiden at Sandown (1m2f, good) last time and stuck his neck out well to win by 1l; some improvement is probably needed going handicapping but he has to be considered seriously in this small field.
runners.comment: Not straightforward, but stuck his neck out to win in cheekpieces in a 1m2f Sandown maiden

runners.name: Nap Hand
runners.spotlight: Minor honours over 1m3f/1m4f in his two Flat handicaps this term (his last runs for Alan King) prior to his creditable second 19 days ago for new yard over hurdles; should be a serious player.
runners.comment: Minor honours on his last two runs for Alan King, prior to a recent second over hurdles

runners.name: Devil's Peak
runners.spotlight: A string of minor honours but no win from his eight races; disappointing on good to firm at Ascot in May, in between showing his best form at Kempton (1m3f, AW) and Sandown (1m2f, good); blinkers were fitted for that latest start, when he came from the back for fifth of 12 despite carrying his head high, and this race is markedly less competitive.
runners.comment: String of minor honours but no win; blinkered latest when carrying head high but best form

runners.name: Magnatura
runners.spotlight: Unraced on good to firm except on debut (fourth); won twice from five starts as 2yo and creditable fourth of ten here on reappearance; faded right out of it at Newmarket (also 1m on good) four weeks later, which sees him visored today with a step up in trip; may need overall improvement.
runners.comment: Faded right out of it at Newmarket latest; visored today with a step up in trip

runners.name: Cloth Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Best efforts on AW, including second at Newcastle (1m2f) late last month; never dangerous when 16-1 at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) nine days later, but today's race is much less competitive than his other two turf handicaps this term.
runners.comment: Best efforts AW; this is much less competitive than his other two turf handicaps this term

races.race_name: Discover Newmarket Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Gracious Gift
runners.spotlight: Flattered to get so close when chasing home a stablemate who easily won five-runner Yarmouth novice (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; that was still an encouraging first go and she's got the scope to progress.
runners.comment: Encouraging first go when chasing home a stablemate 15 days ago; has the scope to progress

runners.name: Graceful Song
runners.spotlight: By Dubawi; first foal; dam 7f-10.5f winner (including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 108), half-sister to multiple 9.5f-10.5f Group 1/Grade 1 winner State Of Rest, is granddaughter of 1m2f Listed winner; powerful yard is looking strong in the 2yo department and she's an obvious contender on this debut.
runners.comment: By Dubawi; powerful yard looking strong in the 2yo department; obvious contender on debut

runners.name: Somers Isles
runners.spotlight: Churchill filly and 44,000euros yearling who went for 170,000euros after a breeze-up in May; first foal; dam 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/AW; RPR 93), half-sister to winners Powerful Breeze (1m 2yo Group 2) and Power To Exceed (6f), out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; a likely newcomer from respected yard.
runners.comment: Churchill filly who went for 170,000euros as a breeze-up in May; a likely newcomer

runners.name: Foxsbrush
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns foal by Lope Y Fernandez; fourth foal; half-sister to Polish 7f 2yo winner Damashal; dam 6f winner (RPR 70), out of unraced sister to 7f/1m winner Mustaqbal; best watched on this introduction unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: 1,000gns foal by Lope Y Fernandez; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise

runners.name: Thuritha
runners.spotlight: Too Darn Hot sixth foal; half-sister to winners Raja Raja (1m4f AW; RPR 104) and Chola Empire (7f AW including October 2yo debut; 85); dam 6f/7f AW winner (including 2yo; 83), out of unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Keraka; look for any market clues on this debut.
runners.comment: Too Darn Hot sixth foal; look for any market clues on this debut

runners.name: Tie A Navyribbon
runners.spotlight: Mohaather first foal; dam 1m AW winner (RPR 69), half-sister to winners Chocoya (useful 6f including 2yo) and Chiringuita (6f 2yo/7.5f), out of 7f 2yo/1m winner; probably best watched on her first go.
runners.comment: Mohaather first foal; probably best watched on her first go

runners.name: Princess Lottie
runners.spotlight: Sent off 100-1 and the penny appeared to be dropping late on when beaten 16l on her debut over C&D (good) four weeks ago; most likely capable of better but will still need to take a good step forward.
runners.comment: 100-1 and the penny appeared to drop late when beaten 16l on debut over C&D (good)
runners.owner: The Ten Fools & A Horse Partnership

races.race_name: Racing Welfare Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Cerro Blanco
runners.spotlight: Both runs have been on the other Newmarket course; won at 4-9 on debut in April (7f, good) and runner-up in Listed race on May 1 (7f, good to firm), when last seen; has by far the best form in this line-up.
runners.comment: Listed runner-up in May on second start and he has by far the best form in this line-up

runners.name: Vastern
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 8-1 on debut at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and kept on for second, albeit no match for the winner; a chunk of improvement is needed if he's to bother Cerro Blanco but it was a promising start to his career and he should have more to offer.
runners.comment: Promising second on recent debut at Chepstow and he should have more to offer

runners.name: Anncanya
runners.spotlight: 1,800gns foal; first foal; dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 99) for connections, half-sister to three winners, out of 8.6f 2yo winner from talented family; a market check is advised but this Advertise newcomer may be best watched.
runners.comment: 1,800gns foal; dam was a useful 2yo for connections but she may be best watched

runners.name: La Mariposa
runners.spotlight: Left her debut run behind when eighth of 11 at 250-1 at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last month but was still soundly beaten and she needs another big step forward today.
runners.comment: Better effort on her second start but still soundly beaten; needs another big step forward
runners.owner: L J Vaessen And Stephen Barber

runners.name: Parc Dosne
runners.spotlight: Made debut last month and not devoid of ability on his two starts (1m2f, soft/good); however, soundly beaten each time and lots of improvement is needed on stable debut; sold out of Andrew Balding's yard for 10,000gns.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten last month on first two starts; lots of improvement needed on stable debut

runners.name: Livemore
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider and slowly away when 11l fifth of seven at 20-1 on debut at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in May; this 45,000gns yearling is open to improvement but may be of greater interest when tackling further.
runners.comment: Open to improvement on second run but he may be of greater interest when tackling further

runners.name: El Carrusel
runners.spotlight: He raced seven times during last season's 2yo campaign and showed only very modest form; looks up against it on his reappearance.
runners.comment: He raced seven times during last season's 2yo campaign and showed only very modest form
runners.owner: The Boys Are Back In Town

races.race_name: Racing TV Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Patrol
runners.spotlight: Last won when sharing the spoils at Southwell (1m4f, AW) over 15 months ago but he was in good form this spring and can be excused his latest effort on account of soft ground; ran well on his only previous visit here too; considered.
runners.comment: Can be excused latest on account of soft ground; ran well sole start here; not ruled out

runners.name: Cranachan
runners.spotlight: Still looked a touch raw when bagging 1m4f Catterick maiden (good) in April but he didn't build on that when fourth of five on his handicap debut at Doncaster four weeks ago; still early days and the added blinkers may help.
runners.comment: Fourth of five on handicap debut four weeks ago; early days and added blinkers may help

runners.name: Level Look
runners.spotlight: Has made good strides across three AW starts, latterly winning four-runner novice at Newcastle (1m2f) in January; goes up in trip again for this turf/handicap debut and market support would increase confidence on this first start since.
runners.comment: Improved for novice win (1m2f) in January; up in trip for turf/handicap debut; considered

runners.name: Counter Intuitive
runners.spotlight: She is another that has been getting her act together, most recently winning a five-runner Thirsk novice (1m4f, good) one month ago; opening mark looks reasonable; leading candidate.
runners.comment: Improving and won novice (1m4f, good) one month ago; opening mark reasonable; player

races.race_name: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: High Degree
runners.spotlight: His only race on firmer than good was on debut, when runner-up; sole win came in a 1m Ffos Las maiden as 3yo; that's from nine races and despite being favourite in his last five handicaps but all three starts this season (1m2f, 1m and 1m1f; never nearer at evens last time) confirmed that he is well capable of being seriously involved.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in his last five handicaps but well capable of being seriously involved

runners.name: Darn Hot Gallop
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner last November who also took a handicap at Newmarket (1m, good) in April; unsurprisingly lost her unbeaten record in the 1,000 Guineas (80-1) and her handicap at Royal Ascot (again 1m on good to firm; 25-1) was pretty tough too but she was well beaten in the latter; this should be vastly more manageable and there's more than enough stamina in her family to boost interest.
runners.comment: 1,000 Guineas and Royal Ascot were much too tough; stamina in family boosts interest

runners.name: Percy's Daydream
runners.spotlight: Made the running when 1m2f handicap winner (good to firm) this year at Doncaster and Beverley; 25-1 and again set the pace when fourth of five in Listed race at Beverley (1m4f) 13 days ago, which was another good run but whether it's worth another 3lb rise in today's mark can be questioned.
runners.comment: In good form but whether her Listed 4th of 5 is worth another 3lb rise can be questioned

runners.name: Way Of Life
runners.spotlight: He's had a long career but never been better than this season, winning at Wolverhampton (9.4f) and Lingfield (1m4f) with a close third in between; they were all on AW in March/April under Olivia Tubb and he's not raced since, with turf runs in the last two years hinting that he's not quite so good in this sphere; also, the last time he raced on firmer than good was 2022.
runners.comment: Never better in long career but that was on AW; unraced on firmer than good since 2022

runners.name: War Hawk
runners.spotlight: AW and dual turf winner over about 1m2f last April-June; some minor honours in his November-March campaign in the UAE, mostly on dirt, without reproducing best efforts; tongue tied first time for today's return from four months off and he needs to be back at his peak; has a bit to prove on firmer than good (after one attempt) but his yard is among the winners.
runners.comment: Off since March (UAE); bit to prove on firmer than good (one go) with first tongue-tie

runners.name: Al Aali
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 16 races came in France (9.5f, AW) as a 2yo; sinking in the weights and well handicapped judged on plenty of 2025 French form, with a step back in the right direction when fifth of 14 at Sandown (1m2f) on penultimate start; not at all discredited in a hot race here 13 days ago when the move up to 1m4f may have stretched him; wore first-time cheekpieces that day and blinkers are now given a go; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Not at all discredited in a hot race here 13 days ago when 1m4f may have stretched him

races.race_name: Madness Handicap

runners.name: Valley Ofthe Kings
runners.spotlight: Both wins came on AW but he's fine on turf and it was a career best on turf when second of nine here (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; might have been flattered by bagging the near rail that day but he won his only previous start at 5f and can't be dismissed.
runners.comment: Career best on turf when second here (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; can't be dismissed

runners.name: Travel Agent
runners.spotlight: Good run of form in the spring included successive wins on AW in April and solid second on turf (also 6f wearing eye-shields) in May; not so good subsequently and he couldn't justify a strong market move back on AW a fortnight ago; bit to prove on this drop back to 5f but last time was a step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Hasn't added to two 6f AW wins in the spring; bit to prove dropping back to 5f

runners.name: Diomed Duke
runners.spotlight: Ran out of puff having lost a shoe at Windsor on his comeback last month and he again faded having attempted to make all over C&D (good to firm) 19 days later; becoming attractively handicapped, however, and could be building up to something bigger.
runners.comment: Two runs this term leave him attractively handicapped; could be building up to a big run

runners.name: Tuscan Point
runners.spotlight: Started well for this yard but the wheels have come off lately, finishing last over C&D one month ago then finishing tailed off on AW last Monday; not easy to suggest after that.
runners.comment: Started well for this yard but the wheels have come off lately; not easy to suggest

runners.name: Grandlad
runners.spotlight: Six wins, all at 5f, include five on turf, most recently when making a winning reappearance at Nottingham (good) in April; slight concern that his sole run here was his worst but he's won off this mark and looks a player.
runners.comment: Winning reappearance over 5f (good) in April; he's won off this mark and looks a player

runners.name: Ecclefechan
runners.spotlight: 0-13 and he hasn't suggested he's about to cash in on a reduced mark, including when sixth of ten at Carlisle (7f) last Thursday; he's never gone closer than when a neck second at Musselburgh last August on his sole start at 5f, however, which could be a straw to clutch to.
runners.comment: Hasn't suggested he's about to cash in on reduced mark but second go at 5f looks worth it

runners.name: Rogue Bullet
runners.spotlight: Three wins include a successful stable debut at Brighton (5.5f, good to firm) and he wasn't beaten far under a penalty when fourth of five at Lingfield (5f, AW) three weeks ago; career-high mark but he's respected.
runners.comment: Won on stable debut (5.5f, good to firm) and not beaten far under a penalty last time

runners.name: Rocking Ends
runners.spotlight: He's on a hat-trick in this race and followed last year's win by also scoring at Windsor and Yarmouth (all 5f on good to firm in cheekpieces) in August; no wins since but he didn't get much cover when midfield over C&D one week ago and his race record means he can't be discounted; also ran well sole previous go in a visor.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick in this race and didn't get much cover when midfield over C&D one week ago

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Angel Shared
runners.spotlight: Has a very good C&D record with three wins (all good to firm) last term; had dipped below her last winning mark when attempting to make it four three weeks ago, so her sixth of seven behind Powdering was underwhelming; dropped a further 2lb and she's not readily dismissed.
runners.comment: Has good C&D record with three wins; latest was underwhelming though

runners.name: Lady Kodiac
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f AW novice winner who was competing in just her third handicap when posting a career best for second at Southwell (6f, AW) off this mark four weeks ago; needs to carry that progress back to turf but she's unexposed and likely capable of better again.
runners.comment: Career best when second (6f, AW) off this mark four weeks ago; can likely do better again

runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner at up to 1m who scored for the ninth time when landing a not dissimilar event over C&D three weeks ago; has never won off a mark this high but seems to be getting quicker as she ages and has gone back-to-back before.
runners.comment: Multiple winner at up to 1m; won over C&D three weeks ago; respected

runners.name: Rose Of Honour
runners.spotlight: 2-2 in AW novices last year and she retained her unbeaten record on handicap debut at Doncaster (also 6f, good to firm) in May; drop to 5f and soft ground didn't see her replicate her best in Ayr Listed event four weeks ago but better can be expected in this scenario.
runners.comment: Won handicap debut in May; 5f and soft ground excuse last time; player in this scenario

runners.name: Elara May
runners.spotlight: Constant progress last year saw her win four nurseries (5f, sound turf and AW) and she completed her season with very creditable fourth of 19 in a Listed event at the other Newmarket track (6f, good) in October; look for market interest ahead of this reappearance.
runners.comment: Constant progress last year saw her win four nurseries; look for market support on return

runners.name: Novamay
runners.spotlight: She rattled off a hat-trick at 6f on good ground around this time last year and was back in the groove when scoring at Ayr (6f, soft) four weeks ago; has been put back to her career-high mark (0-2) but there's a solid chance she can defy it this time.
runners.comment: Hat-trick at 6f on good ground around this time last year; won latest; player

runners.name: Shallow
runners.spotlight: Beat five others to win this race off 3lb higher last year and she chased home Powdering over C&D three weeks ago; bombed out in a better race over 7f here on Saturday but that might be best ignored; visor enlisted.
runners.comment: Won this race off 3lb higher last year; latest run might be best ignored; visor goes on

runners.name: Sing The Blues
runners.spotlight: Won Goodwood novice (6f, good) in October for William Haggas and her handicap debut the following month can be written off (lame); joined her new yard for 6,000gns at the start of this month and best watched unless the market speaks positively.
runners.comment: Won novice (6f) in October for William Haggas; joined new yard for 6,000gns recently

races.race_name: Burwell Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Mister Mojito
runners.spotlight: Last win came at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) in May 2025; has slipped to a dangerous mark and any market support should be noted.
runners.comment: Last won in May 2025 but has slipped to a dangerous mark

runners.name: Born A Rebel
runners.spotlight: Can miss the break but she won this race last year off 10lb lower and swiftly got over a Chester aberration when second of 11 here (1m, good to firm) under Arron D'Arcy four weeks ago; a player.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 10lb lower; solid second of 11 here (1m, good to firm) latest

runners.name: Sedgemoor
runners.spotlight: Sole win on turf came over two years ago and his last two efforts have been moderate; this mark is fine if first-time cheekpieces spark him back to life, however.
runners.comment: Last two efforts have been moderate; mark fine if first-time cheekpieces spark him up

runners.name: Coolagh Magic
runners.spotlight: Veteran who gained a first win on turf in Yarmouth classified event (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; work to do back in a handicap but this isn't the deepest of contests.
runners.comment: First win on turf in classified event three weeks ago; work to do back in a handicap
runners.owner: Lady Emma Oshea And A Carson

runners.name: Chloe's Courage
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Chelmsford in December and nearly doubled up at Lingfield (also 7f, AW) that month; way off that when last seen in January though and would become of interest only with market support on this comeback.
runners.comment: Below best when last seen in January; only of interest with market support

runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Has been revitalised since joining this yard with form figures of 23121; latest win came in this headgear combination at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) last Wednesday; drop back to 7f is no problem and she's a leading candidate under the penalty.
runners.comment: 23121 for this yard; won in this headgear combination latest; player under the penalty

runners.name: Alafdhal
runners.spotlight: Solid strike-rate on AW but not so good on turf and latest sixth of 12 at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) will need improving on; nothing wrong with this mark, though.
runners.comment: Solid strike-rate on AW but not so good on turf; nothing wrong with this mark, though

races.race_name: Ampion Electrical Testing And Solar Experts Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Bit Of A Buzz
runners.spotlight: Has been consistent in defeat in maidens over 5f-6f including once over C&D; best effort came at Bellewstown last time and handles a sound surface well, so is a major player on nursery bow.
runners.comment: Consistent in maidens; handles a sound surface well, so is a major player on nursery bow

runners.name: Tatianna
runners.spotlight: Best effort of three came on debut at Cork over this trip on soft ground; below that level twice since, so questions to be answered about her ability to handle this lively surface.
runners.comment: Best effort came on debut at Cork over this trip on soft ground; questions on this ground

runners.name: Mr Montauk
runners.spotlight: All three runs over this trip came within the space of three weeks; best effort came on debut at Naas on good ground; has a shout if resuming progress on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Best effort came on debut at Naas on good ground; has a shout if resuming progress

runners.name: Shafters Legacy
runners.spotlight: Was poor on first two maiden starts but much-improved when third over C&D on soft last time; was nearly 2l in front of Bit Of A Buzz that day but the latter is better suited to drier ground; a major player.
runners.comment: Third over C&D on soft last time and nearly 2l in front of Bit Of A Buzz; a major player

runners.name: Santorini Storm
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three maidens under varying ground conditions; gelded since last run at Naas, which was his best effort; needs to improve, even tackling nurseries now, but not ruled out.
runners.comment: Gelded since last run at Naas, which was his best effort; has to improve but not ruled out

races.race_name: Ampion Electrical Testing And Solar Experts Handicap

runners.name: Viamonte
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 14 runs but some fine efforts in defeat, all over this trip; solid effort again at Bellewstown last time in first-time cheekpieces (retained), just behind Bye Bye Now; a player but needs more.
runners.comment: Solid effort at Bellewstown in first-time cheekpieces (retained); a player but needs more

runners.name: Spirit Above
runners.spotlight: Maiden was just denied over C&D in May before a lesser run on soft back here; probably didn't stay 6.5f at Limerick last time and back to 5f on good ground will suit; headgear worn last time is left off.
runners.comment: Best run came here; probably didn't stay 6.5f at Limerick last time; drop to 5f will suit

runners.name: Practical Move
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far a couple of times in maidens, but didn't progress in AW handicaps over the winter; has to return to best on stable debut after a break.
runners.comment: Didn't progress in AW handicaps over the winter; has to return to best on stable debut

runners.name: Bye Bye Now
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over this trip at Dundalk in March and a solid fourth back there next time; put in a cracking effort from the front on turf debut at Bellewstown behind an in-form rival; up 3lb but can improve from that; big player.
runners.comment: AW winner ran a cracker on turf debut at Bellewstown; up 3lb but can improve; big player

runners.name: Hot To Foxtrot
runners.spotlight: Maiden hasn't built on early promise, but some good runs all the same between turf and AW; third in a big field at the Curragh two starts ago, but a lesser effort on soft over 7f here since; can do better.
runners.comment: Third at the Curragh but a lesser effort on soft over 7f here since; can do better

runners.name: Shamanka
runners.spotlight: Maiden raced mostly on AW for Natalia Lupini and some solid runs up to 1m; the best of two runs for this yard when fourth over C&D on soft a month ago; a player if as effective on this faster ground.
runners.comment: Fourth over C&D on soft a month ago; a player if as effective on this faster ground

runners.name: Dandy Land
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maidens; best handicap run came last time at Bellewstown over this trip when ran on from the rear; hasn't much to find with Bye Bye Now on that run; added visor could help.
runners.comment: Hasn't much to find with Bye Bye Now on Bellewstown run; added visor could help

runners.name: Monastere
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form lately, winning over 6f at Fairyhouse but a lesser effort at Limerick over 6.5f since; should have the speed for this trip, but a few other front-runners in this field too.
runners.comment: Won over 6f at Fairyhouse before a lesser effort at Limerick over 6.5f; can cope with 5f

runners.name: Spirit Of Eagles
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in 2023 won for the second time in a 6f Fairyhouse claimer in May; raised 19lb for that win but has been solid in defeat since including over C&D; got no run at Fairyhouse last time; a player.
runners.comment: Won Fairyhouse claimer and decent runs since; got no run at Fairyhouse last time; a player

runners.name: Snowballs
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden but ran a cracker over this trip at Naas before a lesser run over 6.5f at Limerick since; cheekpieces retained; back to 5f will suit but needs more.
runners.comment: Fifth over this trip at Naas before a lesser run over 6.5f at Limerick; needs more

runners.name: Whatswrongnow
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 32 starts has been mostly running well this season, but getting bumped up in the handicap for being placed isn't helping matters; likely to run well again.
runners.comment: Getting bumped up in the handicap for being placed isn't helping, but likely to run well

runners.name: Raven's Call
runners.spotlight: The best of three maiden runs last year came over C&D; lacks experience for a race of this nature, but yard does well with sprinters and could go well on return.
runners.comment: Lacks experience for a race of this nature, but yard does well with sprinters

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Cashel Queen
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Leopardstown over 7f (soft) and built on that over a mile at Bellewstown on good ground; cheekpieces are added today and can be a major player,  though the drop in trip is a concern.
runners.comment: Improved effort over 1m at Bellewstown; major player though the drop in trip is a concern

runners.name: Seaxburh
runners.spotlight: Both starts came at Roscommon over a similar trip to this; not beaten far on debut, but produced a lesser effort last time; seems to be the yard's second-string, but can be involved if resuming progress.
runners.comment: Seems to be the yard's second-string but can be involved if resuming progress

runners.name: Belicoso
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at the Curragh over 6f behind a smart winner; a lesser run at Listowel since; the step up in trip should suit on breeding and looks to be the yard's first-string, but has to resume progress.
runners.comment: Step up in trip should suit; looks to be the yard first-string but has to resume progress

runners.name: West Of Eden
runners.spotlight: A Eur500,000 yearling; started a short-priced favourite on debut at Navan over 6f but never landed a blow; marginal improvement upped to 7f at Leopardstown since; has to do more today.
runners.comment: Marginal improvement upped to 7f at Leopardstown last time; has to do more today

runners.name: Give Me Liberty
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in two maidens and will be better off in nurseries after this; visor added.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in two maidens and will be better off in nurseries after this; visor on

runners.name: Thatsanotherstory
runners.spotlight: Similar efforts in 6f maidens at Cork and Navan the last twice; has to do more up in trip and mixed messages about stamina in pedigree.
runners.comment: Three runs over 6f; has to do more up in trip and mixed messages about stamina in pedigree

races.race_name: Ampion Electrical Testing And Solar Experts Maiden

runners.name: Camelot Queen
runners.spotlight: Front-running third over 1m2f at Leopardstown; weakened over 1m4f on testing ground at Cork; third over C&D last month and the second easily went one better at Killarney on Monday; has only run on yielding or worse; headgear.
runners.comment: Third over C&D last month; second easily went one better at Killarney on Monday

runners.name: Chosen One
runners.spotlight: Ran well in red-hot 1m maiden at Naas on her return; again stable second-string (20-1) when running much the same race over same C&D last month; dam 1m2f Listed winner, sister to Irish Derby winner Latrobe, so Dubawi filly is bred to get this trip, although the visual evidence from her two runs this year is inconclusive in that regard.
runners.comment: Two good runs in 1m maidens at Naas; bred to stay this far, but visual evidence is unclear
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Hamiyan
runners.spotlight: Second at Galway festival and Gowran third to this year's Derby winner Christmas Day were the pick of his 2yo soft-ground maiden efforts; disappointed on seasonal return in Curragh handicap; back from a break with much better effort over 1m on good ground at Leopardstown last week; cheekpieces stay on; Aga Khan damline suggests he'll stay, but that remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Much better effort over 1m on good ground at Leopardstown, when fourth off 77 in handicap
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Youcansaythatagain
runners.spotlight: Ghaiyyath colt from a talented Juddmonte family; 18s for quick-ground 1m2f Curragh maiden on Derby weekend, showed ability when beaten 5l by winner who now sits on a mark of 88; spoilt his chance significantly by hanging left up the straight; form of that run yet to be tested.
runners.comment: Showed ability when beaten 5l in 1m2f Curragh maiden on Derby weekend, but hung badly left

runners.name: Trovao Dourado
runners.spotlight: Dandy Man 4yo is brother to Italian 6f-7.5f winner; cost 7,000 euros as a yearling; dam 6f winner, out of US 7f/1m winning half-sister to US 1m Grade 2 winner Habaya; respected yard, but best watched unless money arrives.
runners.comment: Dandy Man 4yo is brother to Italian 6f-7.5f winner; cost 7,000 euros as a yearling

runners.name: Royal Ballet Blue
runners.spotlight: Elzaam colt; dam unraced half-sister to Scandinavian 1m-8.6f winner, out of 1m2f winning half-sister to Listed winners Coupe De Ville (1m 2yo) and Fantastico Robert (US 1m1f); young trainer having a good season, but this one is best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: Elzaam colt; dam unraced half-sister to Scandinavian 1m-8.6f winner; one to note if backed

runners.name: Spry
runners.spotlight: Nice Jim Bolger pedigree but showed nothing in 1m4f maiden on debut; tongue-tie discarded.
runners.comment: Nice Jim Bolger pedigree but showed nothing in 1m4f maiden on debut; tongue-tie discarded

runners.name: Storzando
runners.spotlight: River Boyne gelding from good family; 66s, sixth to Irish 2,000 Guineas also-ran Bamako Beach over 7f at Fairyhouse, but he was beaten miles.
runners.comment: 66s, remote sixth to Irish 2,000 Guineas also-ran Bamako Beach over 7f at Fairyhouse

runners.name: Chloe's Boy
runners.spotlight: Well beaten both starts; will be in handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Well beaten both starts; will be in handicaps after this

races.race_name: GAIN The Advantage Series Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Searcog
runners.spotlight: Trainer's four-timer last weekend makes this 1m1f winner of interest; narrowly beaten over 1m3f here in September, too, and some decent runs hurdling during the winter; nice run over 1m at Leopardstown but unplaced at Navan since; tongue-tie left off; doubt she wants it too fast.
runners.comment: 1m1f winner last term and went close over 1m3f here; back from a break and yard flying

runners.name: Rising Sky
runners.spotlight: AW winner over 10.5f in March and her higher-grade third at Naas was a good effort; 1m4f has seemed a bridge too far, though, and long way behind Masego over that trip at Bellewstown; excuse for latest run (1m2f) at Navan.
runners.comment: Higher-grade third at Naas was a good effort; long way behind Masego at Bellewstown

runners.name: Masego
runners.spotlight: Bit of promise over hurdles last year for Mags Mullins; made all to beat 18 rivals over this trip on good ground at Leopardstown; little wrong with stable debut third over 1m4f at Bellewstown (second touched off since); 2lb wrong matters little and front-runner is a player.
runners.comment: Made all over this trip at Leopardstown; little wrong with stable debut third over 1m4f

runners.name: Booklight
runners.spotlight: Placed at two and went close to making all in 1m4f Leopardstown handicap last year, only beaten half-a-length; left Natalia Lupini after; tailed off on stable debut last month.
runners.comment: Went close in 1m4f Leopardstown handicap last year; tailed off on stable debut

runners.name: Numidia
runners.spotlight: Five wins, two of them on turf, including 25-1 success over extended 1m6f at Bellewstown earlier this month; needed every yard that day, and his previous win was over 2m; got an 8lb rise, which is likely to prevent a follow-up; placed once in seven previous runs here.
runners.comment: 25-1 winner over extended 1m6f at Bellewstown; 8lb rise likely to prevent a follow-up

runners.name: Banana Three
runners.spotlight: Consistent on AW at three, winning over 1m4f; had some good hurdling form, without winning, in 2024; just one run over flights last year; ran well in a charity race at the Curragh on Derby weekend; has to enter calculations in such a weak contest.
runners.comment: Ran well in a charity race at the Curragh on Derby weekend; has to enter calculations

runners.name: Memories Maker
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in soft-ground 1m4f handicap at Doncaster at three for Charlie Johnston; lightly raced for this yard; okay run over hurdles last year; out the back in 1m2f Roscommon handicap when last seen.
runners.comment: Out the back in 1m2f Roscommon handicap when last seen over a year ago

races.race_name: Ampion Electrical Testing And Solar Experts Fillies & Mares Handicap

runners.name: Alba Chiara
runners.spotlight: Sole win came here in last year's Ulster Cesarewitch over 2m2f; a fine effort over this trip back here next time; however, has been well below her best in three runs this term; has to rebound; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Has been well below her best in three runs this term and has to bounce back; tongue-tie on
runners.owner: Mrs Tracey O'Hare & D W Sloan & William Jones

runners.name: Stellar Quality
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m4f maiden at Bellewstown last August on second start; first two runs this season were solid, but was poor at Ballinrobe last time; only dropped 1lb and needs more, but cheekpieces might help.
runners.comment: Poor at Ballinrobe last time; only dropped 1lb and needs more, but cheekpieces might help

runners.name: Teologia
runners.spotlight: Has shown improved form lately when winning twice at this track over extended 1m2f, a maiden on good ground and a 3yo handicap on soft; raised 13lb for latter success, but still has to be taken seriously; should stay this trip.
runners.comment: Two 1m2f wins here; up 13lb for latter success but still taken seriously; should stay trip

runners.name: Beauparc
runners.spotlight: Two wins apiece on turf and AW up to 1m4f; best turf effort this term when second at Gowran last month; not as good over 1m2f twice since; stepping back up to this trip will suit and cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Second at Gowran last month; not as good over 1m2f twice since; cheekpieces added

runners.name: La Dame Blanche
runners.spotlight: The last of her three wins came at Ballinrobe off 14lb higher nearly two years ago; has been regressive in the last year and needs to do more, even off a falling mark
runners.comment: Has been regressive in the last year and needs to do more, even off a falling mark

races.race_name: Ampion Electrical Testing And Solar Experts Handicap

runners.name: Chapel Island
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in a Galway maiden last year when with Mick Mulvany; well backed into joint-favouritism for return at Fairyhouse, but didn't feature; off the bridle 3f out when okay fifth here over 10.5f (soft); had a wide trip from a bad draw when fourth over 1m3f at Naas and reckon he's on a good mark now; not bred to stay, but might.
runners.comment: Had a wide trip from a bad draw when fourth over 1m3f at Naas; not bred to stay, but might

runners.name: Nephin Mountain
runners.spotlight: Twice made the frame in soft-ground 7f Gowran handicaps in the spring; finished well when fourth against older horses over 1m1f on fast ground at Leopardstown, but bombed over 1m3f at Naas last time; yet to string two good runs together and trip is a big question mark.
runners.comment: Fourth against older horses over 1m1f on fast ground at Leopardstown, but bombed at Naas

runners.name: Onyeisi
runners.spotlight: Had fair AW form in headgear for Charlie Johnston during the winter, winning over 1m2f and runner-up over 1m4f; better on third Irish start when fourth against older rivals at Fairyhouse (1m2f); starting to stay on from rear when carried wide on the home bend at Ballinrobe; stepping back up in trip might help and can lead.
runners.comment: Fourth against older rivals at Fairyhouse; carried wide on the home bend at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Sea Of Dubka
runners.spotlight: No worries about the trip for this stoutly-bred filly; best of three handicap runs was front-running fourth over 1m4f at Cork in April; winner has gone in again twice and third won maiden next time; was given a break after Roscommon fifth in May.
runners.comment: No trip worries for this stoutly-bred filly; best of three handicap runs was Cork fourth
runners.owner: Anthony Head & Stephen E McCarthy & Mrs Paul Shanahan

runners.name: Glen Echo
runners.spotlight: Quiet in maidens and unable to land a blow when 50s for 1m4f handicap at Limerick; still early days for Snellen's half-brother; dam was 1m4f winner and is half-sister to dam of King George winner Novellist, so no surprise they're giving him another go over a trip.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Snellen was unable to land a blow when 50s for 1m4f handicap at Limerick

runners.name: Leeward
runners.spotlight: Well-bred son of Frankel; couple of respectable maiden runs; only 15-2 for handicap debut over 1m4f at Limerick, a race won easily by stablemate and favourite; dropped out from a bad draw and couldn't go on after making a bit of headway early in the straight; blinkers.
runners.comment: Well-bred son of Frankel was only 15-2 for handicap debut over 1m4f at Limerick; blinkers

runners.name: Augusta Rock
runners.spotlight: Flopped when 3-1 for seasonal/handicap debut at Sligo in May; it was probably soft ground, rather than this trip, which proved his undoing because (having been gelded and given a break) he ran much better over 1m3f at Killarney on Monday; looked slow but kept plugging away, and gets another change of headgear now.
runners.comment: Ran much better over 1m3f at Killarney on Monday; looked slow but kept plugging away

races.race_name: Babs Woolford Memorial Apprentice Classified Stakes

runners.name: Hansteen
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced Sea The Moon gelding who took a big step forward on his handicap debut with a clear second of eight in 1m4f handicap at Ripon 11 days ago; holds very good claims at these weights.
runners.comment: Big step forward on h'cap debut with clear Ripon second; very good claims at these weights

runners.name: Satyress
runners.spotlight: Waldgeist filly who has advanced her form this season, fourth in 1m2f handicap here before gaining a first success at Beverley (1m4f) last month; she can go well again back in classified company.
runners.comment: Gained first win at Beverley last month; she can go well again back in classified company.

runners.name: Muhib
runners.spotlight: Is 0-26 but comes here in good form, third of 11 in C&D handicap ten days ago; needs considering dropping back into classified company.
runners.comment: Is 0-26 but comes here in good form; considered dropping back into classified company.

runners.name: Yakhabar
runners.spotlight: Scored at Southwell (1m4f) in March but only ninth of 11 in handicap over C&D ten days ago; not proving the easiest to catch right of late.
runners.comment: Scored at Southwell (1m4f) in March but only ninth of 11 in handicap over C&D ten days ago

runners.name: Resdev Time
runners.spotlight: Yet to get her head in front and she was tried in cheekpieces when sixth of eight in 1m4f handicap at Ripon 11 days ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces on when sixth of eight at Ripon 11 days ago; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Coverbridge
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in June 2024 but he arrives in decent nick, fifth of 11 in C&D handicap ten days ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: Sole success came in June 2024 but he arrives in decent nick; not out of things

runners.name: Prince Hector
runners.spotlight: Twice second (over 1m2f) in classified company at Chelmsford over the winter but his more recent form is not so encouraging, sixth of 13 in 1m2f classified event at Newcastle last time; on a long losing run too.
runners.comment: Below-par sixth in 1m2f classified event at Newcastle last time; on a long losing run too

runners.name: Balqaa
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways in classified event at Wolverhampton (9.5f) in March; winless on turf though and only eighth of 13 in 1m Ripon handicap last time; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Winless on turf and only eighth of 13 in 1m Ripon handicap last time; others appeal more

races.race_name: G3 Vehicle Auctions EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sea Mirage
runners.spotlight: Naval Crown colt; promising runner-up in 5f Leicester maiden in May but came in last of six in 5f maiden here 30 days ago; since gelded and no surprise to see him bounce back.
runners.comment: Promising runner-up at Leicester but last here since; gelded and can bounce back

runners.name: Turnstile
runners.spotlight: Proving a fair and reliable maiden until beating just two in 6f Leicester seller 13 days ago; needs to take a step forward if he's to get off the mark at the ninth attempt.
runners.comment: Beat two in Leicester seller latest; needs to take step forward if he's to get off mark

runners.name: Maximus Meridius
runners.spotlight: 15-2, made an encouraging start with second of six in maiden at Ayr (6f, soft) 27 days ago; this son of Persian Force is open to progress and must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Encouraging start with second at Ayr; is open to progress and must enter calculations
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Dawlah
runners.spotlight: 17,000gns yearling, 3,500gns 2yo breeze-ups; half-sister to winners Havana Angel (French Group-placed 5.5f 2yo; RPR 88) and Foothold (1m; 69); dam, 1m4f winner (69), is a half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Sweet Cecily; hooded for her debut and the market can guide for this Naval Crown filly.
runners.comment: Hooded for her debut and the market can guide for this Naval Crown filly

runners.name: King Of Persia
runners.spotlight: Bated Breath colt who has hinted at promise on both his runs, not enjoying the smoothest of passages with seventh of 11 in 7f Carlisle maiden 23 days ago; looks to be one for the longer term.
runners.comment: Has hinted at promise on both his runs; looks to be one for the longer term

runners.name: Angel In My Heart
runners.spotlight: Sent off 28-1 but showed some promise when a debut fourth of six in novice at Catterick (5f, good to firm) nine days ago; this Harry Angel filly can take a step forward.
runners.comment: Some promise when debut fourth at Catterick; this Harry Angel filly can build on it

runners.name: Baldetti
runners.spotlight: 11-1, shaped well when a debut third of ten in maiden at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in May, keeping on late; this longer trip promises to suit this son of Minzaal so he's a big player.
runners.comment: Shaped well when debut third at Leicester; a big player with longer trip promising to suit
runners.owner: G H Thompson And Michael Dods

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap

runners.name: Hover On The Wind
runners.spotlight: Right back to his best of late, landing back-to-back C&D handicaps; this is tougher under a 5lb penalty but he can't be dismissed in his hat-trick attempt.
runners.comment: Back to best of late, landing back-to-back C&D h'caps; not dismissed in hat-trick attempt

runners.name: Badri
runners.spotlight: Arrives in fine form and bidding for a hat-trick following back-to-back 6f wins here, emphatically making all on latter occasion; has won over the minimum trip too so rates a big player under a 4lb penalty.
runners.comment: On hat-trick after back-to-back 6f wins here; rates a big player under a 4lb penalty

runners.name: I'm Next
runners.spotlight: Is enjoying an excellent season and gained a third success when making all in 5f Beverley handicap two weeks ago; up 3lb but not taken lightly in his hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Made all at Beverley two weeks ago; up 3lb but not taken lightly in his hat-trick bid

runners.name: Baker Blue
runners.spotlight: Much improved when an easy winner at Wolverhampton (5f) in February but well below par in Chantilly Listed race (5.5f) and handicap at Royal Ascot (5f) since; no surprise to see him bounce back here.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Wolverhampton but well below par in better company since; can bounce back

runners.name: Sir Yoshi
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful ex-Irish 5f winner; yet to hit top form for his current yard but better signs when ninth of 14 in 5f Newcastle handicap three weeks ago; no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark if building on it.
runners.comment: Better signs for current yard with ninth at Newcastle latest; no forlorn hope here

runners.name: Vantheman
runners.spotlight: Took this prize in 2024; back in fine form of late since fitted with blinkers, scoring at Hamilton (5f) in May and in the frame in big-field 5f handicaps at Thirsk and Newcastle since; ought to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Took this prize in 2024; back in fine form of late since fitted with blinkers; in the mix

runners.name: Reigning Profit
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win of 2026 in 5f handicap at Ripon 11 days ago; usual visor goes back on now and this four-time C&D scorer is not out of things under a 4lb penalty.
runners.comment: Scored at Ripon latest; this four-time C&D scorer is not out of things under 4lb penalty

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap

runners.name: Best Rate
runners.spotlight: Gained a deserved first win since 2024 in 1m apprentices' handicap at Ascot a week ago, when well on top at the finish; escapes a penalty and is able to race off 2lb lower than last time, so he's very hard to side against.
runners.comment: Emphatic winner of Ascot apprentices' event a week ago; escapes a penalty so hard to beat

runners.name: Sailthisshipalone
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with C&D win in April and posted another solid effort with third of nine over C&D ten days ago; considered off the same mark.
runners.comment: C&D winner and a solid third of nine over C&D ten days ago; considered off the same mark

runners.name: Jez Bomb
