runners.spotlight: Often slowly away but not so when gaining a first success of 2026 in seven-runner handicap over C&D 18 days ago; up 3lb but still not out of things.
runners.comment: Landed handicap over C&D 18 days ago; up 3lb but still not out of things

runners.name: Kartini
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who signed off for Oliver Cole with a very good second of ten in 1m2f handicap at Chelmsford in November; since changed hands for 10,000gns and needs to hit the ground running for new yard on her belated return.
runners.comment: Ended time for Oliver Cole with good Chelmsford second; has her fitness to prove on return

runners.name: Empirestateofmind
runners.spotlight: A dual winner (around 1m) in 2025 but he's yet to fire this season, only ninth of 11 in 1m Redcar handicap four weeks ago; others appeal more.
runners.comment: A dual winner (around 1m) in 2025 but he's yet to fire this season; others appeal more

runners.name: Billyb
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with 1m Southwell win and largely in good nick this season, seventh of 14 in 1m Carlisle handicap last month; not ruled out from a slipping mark.
runners.comment: Ended 2025 with 1m Southwell win and largely in good nick this season; not ruled out

races.race_name: Peter Chamberlain Five Year Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Alfa Whiteburd
runners.spotlight: A four-time 6f AW scorer in 2025; built on earlier promise to gain a first turf victory in 7f Chester handicap a week ago, making all and drawing right away last 1f for 8l success; major shout under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Wide-margin winner at Chester a week ago; major shout under a 5lb penalty

runners.name: One Of Our Own
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways at Redcar (6f) in May and has continued in good nick, third of 12 there (6f) last time; this C&D scorer needs considering.
runners.comment: In good nick, third of 12 there (6f) last time; this C&D scorer needs considering

runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence but he got back on track with second of 11 in 6f Carlisle handicap eight days ago; needs to reproduce it here.
runners.comment: Back on track with second in Carlisle handicap eight days ago; needs to reproduce it here

runners.name: Dicko The Legend
runners.spotlight: Yet to score this term but running well, fourth of ten in 5.5f Doncaster handicap eight days ago; he ought to be thereabouts once more.
runners.comment: Yet to score this term but running well; ought to be thereabouts once more
runners.owner: Mrs S Hibbert, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.spotlight: Often a slow starter but he got away on level terms when landing 5.5f Doncaster handicap eight days ago; not out of things under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Landed 5.5f Doncaster handicap eight days ago; not out of things under a 5lb penalty
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Willolarupi
runners.spotlight: Scored at Redcar (6f) last May and signed off for 2025 with a good third of 13 over C&D in October; needs to hit the ground running after nine months off though.
runners.comment: Signed off for 2025 with good C&D third; needs to hit ground running after nine months off

races.race_name: Always Trying Racing Syndicate Handicap

runners.name: Snaafy
runners.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough win at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December but not seen since going too freely when last of five in 1m2f AW handicap at Lingfield in January; yard is going very well though so can't be ruled out back in trip here.
runners.comment: Off since last at Lingfield in January; yard is going very well though so not ruled out

runners.name: Theme Park
runners.spotlight: On a losing run and he looked rusty after eight months off when tenth of 14 in 1m2f handicap at York on his return 20 days ago; this C&D winner can take a step forward here.
runners.comment: On a losing run and tenth at York on recent return; C&D winner can take a step forward

runners.name: Hunterian
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who bagged a deserved first victory at Ayr (1m) in June and not disgraced with sixth of ten there (1m) 11 days ago; needs considering.
runners.comment: Scored at Ayr and not disgraced with sixth there (1m) 11 days ago; needs considering

runners.name: Angela's Baar
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden who has failed to kick on since sent handicapping, just fifth of eight at Ripon (1m2f) last month; visor is reached for now.
runners.comment: Has failed to kick on sent handicapping, fifth of eight at Ripon last month; visor goes on

runners.name: Ravishing Beauty
runners.spotlight: Took this prize 12 months ago and she's back in excellent form of late, scoring at Carlisle (1m) before third of seven over C&D 26 days ago; merits serious consideration in her follow-up bid.
runners.comment: Took this 12 months ago and back in excellent form of late; merits serious consideration

runners.name: Mount King
runners.spotlight: A dual C&D winner in 2025; yet to hit top form this season but took a step back in the right direction with fifth of nine over C&D ten days ago; blinkers replace usual cheekpieces here and not out of things.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in 2025; step back in right direction with C&D fifth; not out of things

runners.name: The New Bay Pearl
runners.spotlight: Placed three times (7f/1m) for Roger Varian in 2025 but yet to show that form in a trio of runs for her current yard, fourth of eight in 1m2f handicap at Ripon 30 days ago; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Placed three times for Roger Varian; yet to show that form in three runs for current yard

runners.name: Bun Bang Fai
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m maiden for Archie Watson at three but not seen since a below-par eighth at Newcastle (1m) in October; has since changed hands for 4,000gns and needs to hit the ground running for her new yard after nine months off.
runners.comment: Fair maiden for Archie Watson; needs to hit ground running for new yard after an absence
